```
   129→def _save(state: dict, plan: dict, state_dir: Path) -> None:
   130→    """Write state + plan to disk."""
   131→    state_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   132→    state_path = state_dir / "state-python.json"
   133→    plan_path = state_dir / "plan.json"
   134→    state_path.write_text(json.dumps(state, indent=2, default=str))
   135→    plan_path.write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2, default=str))
   136→
   137→
   138→def _pause(tmpdir: Path, stage: str, description: str) -> None:
   139→    """Print instructions and wait for user input."""
   140→    print()
   141→    print(f"{'=' * 60}")
   142→    print(f"  STAGE: {stage}")
   143→    print(f"{'=' * 60}")
   144→    print(f"  {description}")
   145→    print()
   146→    print(f"  In another terminal, try:")
   147→    print(f"    DESLOPPIFY_ROOT={tmpdir} python -m desloppify --lang python next")
   148→    print(f"    DESLOPPIFY_ROOT={tmpdir} python -m desloppify --lang python plan")
   149→    print(f"    DESLOPPIFY_ROOT={tmpdir} python -m desloppify --lang python status")
   150→    print()
   151→    input("  Press Enter to advance to next stage...")
   152→
   153→
   154→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   155→# Main walkthrough
   156→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   157→
   158→def main() -> None:
   159→    tmpdir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="desloppify-lifecycle-"))
   160→    state_dir = tmpdir / ".desloppify"
   161→
   162→    # Create minimal source files so scan_path resolves
   163→    src = tmpdir / "src"
   164→    src.mkdir()
   165→    (src / "app.py").write_text("def process_order(): pass\n")
   166→    (src / "util.py").write_text("def do_stuff(): pass\n")
   167→    (src / "helpers.py").write_text("import os.path\n")
   168→
   169→    # Initialize git so get_project_root() works
   170→    os.system(f"git init -q {tmpdir}")
   171→
   172→    print(f"\n  Lifecycle walkthrough sandbox: {tmpdir}")
   173→    print(f"  State dir: {state_dir}")
   174→
   175→    # --- Build base state ---
   176→    state = empty_state()
   177→    state["lang"] = "python"
   178→    state["scan_path"] = "src"
   179→    state["scan_count"] = 1
   180→    state["last_scan"] = utc_now()
   181→    state["issues"] = dict(OBJECTIVE_ISSUES)
   182→    state.setdefault("dimension_scores", {})
   183→    state.setdefault("subjective_assessments", {})
   184→
   185→    plan = empty_plan()
   186→
   187→    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   188→    # Stage 1: Fresh scan — placeholder dimensions (initial reviews)
   189→    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   190→    _apply_dims(state, {k: _placeholder_dim(k) for k in DIM_KEYS})
   191→    sync_unscored_dimensions(plan, state)
   192→    _save(state, plan, state_dir)
   193→
   194→    _pause(tmpdir, "1 — Initial Reviews",
   195→           "Fresh scan. 3 subjective dimensions need initial review.\n"
   196→           "  `next` should show only subjective review items.\n"
   197→           "  Objective issues are hidden until reviews are done.")
   198→
   199→    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   200→    # Stage 2: Reviews completed — objectives unlock
   201→    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   202→    _apply_dims(state, {k: _scored_dim(k, 72.0) for k in DIM_KEYS})
   203→    subj_ids = [fid for fid in plan["queue_order"] if fid.startswith("subjective::")]
   204→    purge_ids(plan, subj_ids)
   205→    state["strict_score"] = 72.0
   206→    state["overall_score"] = 72.0
   207→    state["objective_score"] = 80.0
   208→    _save(state, plan, state_dir)
   209→
   210→    _pause(tmpdir, "2 — Reviews Complete (between scans)",
   211→           "All 3 reviews done (scored at 72). Subjective IDs purged from plan.\n"
   212→           "  `next` should now show objective issues.\n"
   213→           "  No workflow items yet — hasn't been scanned since reviews.")
   214→
   215→    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   216→    # Stage 3: Next scan — communicate-score + create-plan injected
   217→    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   218→    state["scan_count"] = 2
   219→    state["last_scan"] = utc_now()
   220→    sync_communicate_score_needed(plan, state)
   221→    sync_create_plan_needed(plan, state)
   222→    _save(state, plan, state_dir)
   223→
   224→    _pause(tmpdir, "3 — Post-scan: Workflow Items Injected",
   225→           "Simulated a second scan. Reconcile injected:\n"
   226→           "  - workflow::communicate-score (show your scores)\n"
   227→           "  - workflow::create-plan (organize your backlog)\n"
   228→           "  `next` should show communicate-score first.")
   229→
   230→    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   231→    # Stage 4: Workflow items completed — pure objective work
   232→    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   233→    purge_ids(plan, [WORKFLOW_COMMUNICATE_SCORE_ID, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID])
   234→    _save(state, plan, state_dir)
   235→
   236→    _pause(tmpdir, "4 — Workflow Complete: Objective Work",
   237→           "communicate-score and create-plan resolved.\n"
   238→           "  `next` should show the highest-impact objective issue.\n"
   239→           "  `plan` should show the full backlog.")
   240→
   241→    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   242→    # Stage 5: Review issues appear → triage stages
   243→    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   244→    review_issues = {
   245→        "review::src/app.py::naming-concern": {
   246→            "id": "review::src/app.py::naming-concern",
   247→            "detector": "review",
   248→            "file": "src/app.py",
   249→            "tier": 2,
   250→            "confidence": "high",
   251→            "summary": "Naming quality: function names in src/app.py don't follow conventions",
   252→            "detail": {"dimension": "naming_quality"},
   253→            "status": "open",
   254→            "first_seen": utc_now(),
   255→            "last_seen": utc_now(),
   256→            "resolved_at": None,
   257→            "reopen_count": 0,
   258→        },
   259→        "review::src/util.py::logic-concern": {
   260→            "id": "review::src/util.py::logic-concern",
   261→            "detector": "review",
   262→            "file": "src/util.py",
   263→            "tier": 2,
   264→            "confidence": "high",
   265→            "summary": "Logic clarity: complex branching in src/util.py needs simplification",
   266→            "detail": {"dimension": "logic_clarity"},
   267→            "status": "open",
   268→            "first_seen": utc_now(),
   269→            "last_seen": utc_now(),
   270→            "resolved_at": None,
   271→            "reopen_count": 0,
   272→        },
   273→    }
   274→    state["issues"].update(review_issues)
   275→    state["scan_count"] = 3
   276→    state["last_scan"] = utc_now()
   277→    sync_triage_needed(plan, state)
   278→    _save(state, plan, state_dir)
   279→
   280→    _pause(tmpdir, "5 — Review Issues: Triage Needed",
   281→           "New review issues surfaced from subjective analysis.\n"
   282→           "  Triage stages injected (observe → reflect → organize → commit).\n"
   283→           "  `next` should show triage stages before objective work.")
   284→
   285→    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   286→    # Stage 6: Triage complete → back to objectives
   287→    # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   288→    purge_ids(plan, list(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS))
   289→    _save(state, plan, state_dir)
   290→
   291→    _pause(tmpdir, "6 — Triage Complete: Back to Work",
   292→           "All triage stages resolved. Back to objective work.\n"
   293→           "  `next` should show objective + review issues ranked by impact.\n"
   294→           "  This is the steady-state work phase.")
   295→
   296→    print()
   297→    print(f"  Walkthrough complete! Sandbox at: {tmpdir}")
   298→    print(f"  Clean up with: rm -rf {tmpdir}")
   299→    print()
   300→
   301→
   302→if __name__ == "__main__":
   303→    main()
   304→
```

```
     2→
     3→Exercises the full lifecycle by walking through each stage:
     4→  scan → initial reviews → communicate-score → create-plan → triage → objectives
     5→
     6→Between scans, items are completed via ``purge_ids`` (what ``plan resolve``
     7→does) and the queue is re-checked without reconciling.  ``reconcile`` only
     8→runs at scan boundaries — matching the real CLI flow.
     9→"""

    51→    """(display_name, dim_scores_entry, subjective_assessment) for a placeholder."""
    52→    return (

    54→        {

    56→            "detectors": {"subjective_assessment": {"placeholder": True, "dimension_key": key}},
    57→        },

    88→    for display, dim_entry, assessment in dims:
```

```
1→#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2→"""CI Roslyn shim for C# integration tests.
     3→
     4→This script emits Roslyn-like JSON payloads from the existing heuristic
     5→C# dependency graph so integration tests can exercise the Roslyn command
     6→path in a deterministic, self-contained way.
     7→"""
     8→
     9→from __future__ import annotations
    10→
    11→import json
    12→import os
    13→import sys
    14→from pathlib import Path
    15→
    16→from desloppify.languages.csharp.detectors.deps import build_dep_graph
    17→
    18→
    19→def main() -> int:
    20→    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
    21→        print("Usage: roslyn_stub.py <scan_path>", file=sys.stderr)
    22→        return 2
    23→
    24→    scan_path = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
    25→
    26→    # Prevent recursive invocation when this command is used via
    27→    # DESLOPPIFY_CSHARP_ROSLYN_CMD inside build_dep_graph.
    28→    os.environ.pop("DESLOPPIFY_CSHARP_ROSLYN_CMD", None)
    29→
    30→    graph = build_dep_graph(scan_path)
    31→    payload = {
    32→        "files": [
    33→            {
    34→                "file": source,
    35→                "imports": sorted(entry.get("imports", set())),
    36→            }
    37→            for source, entry in sorted(graph.items())
    38→        ]
    39→    }
    40→    print(json.dumps(payload))
    41→    return 0
    42→
    43→
    44→if __name__ == "__main__":
    45→    raise SystemExit(main())
    46→
```

1→# Desloppify - an agent harness to make your codebase 🤌
     2→
     3→[![PyPI version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/desloppify)](https://pypi.org/project/desloppify/) ![Python 3.11+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.11%2B-blue)
     4→
     5→Desloppify gives your AI coding agent the tools to identify, understand, and systematically improve codebase quality. It combines mechanical detection (dead code, duplication, complexity) with subjective LLM review (naming, abstractions, module boundaries), then works through a prioritized fix loop. State persists across scans so it chips away over multiple sessions, and the scoring is designed to resist gaming.
     6→
     7→<img src="assets/explained.png" width="100%">
     8→
     9→The score gives your agent a north-star, and the tooling helps it plan, execute, and resolve issues until it hits your target — with a lot of tricks to keep it on track. A score above 98 should correlate with a codebase a seasoned engineer would call beautiful.
    10→
    11→That score generates a scorecard badge for your GitHub profile or README:
    12→
    13→<img src="assets/scorecard.png" width="100%">
    14→
    15→Currently supports 28 languages — full plugin depth for TypeScript, Python, C#, Dart, GDScript, and Go; generic linter + tree-sitter support for Rust, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, and 17 more.
    16→
    17→## For your agent's consideration...
    18→
    19→Paste this prompt into your agent:
    20→
    21→```
    22→I want you to improve the quality of this codebase. To do this, install and run desloppify.
    23→Run ALL of the following (requires Python 3.11+):
    24→
    25→pip install --upgrade "desloppify[full]"
    26→desloppify update-skill claude    # installs the full workflow guide — pick yours: claude, cursor, codex, copilot, windsurf, gemini
    27→
    28→Before scanning, check for directories that should be excluded (vendor, build output,
    29→generated code, worktrees, etc.) and exclude obvious ones with `desloppify exclude <path>`.
    30→Share any questionable candidates with me before excluding.
    31→
    32→desloppify scan --path .
    33→desloppify next
    34→
    35→--path is the directory to scan (use "." for the whole project, or "src/" etc).
    36→
    37→Your goal is to get the strict score as high as possible. The scoring resists gaming — the
    38→only way to improve it is to actually make the code better.
    39→
    40→THE LOOP: run `next`. It tells you what to fix, which file, and the resolve command to run
    41→when done. Fix it, resolve it, run `next` again. Over and over. This is your main job.
    42→
    43→Don't be lazy. Large refactors and small detailed fixes — do both with equal energy. No task
    44→is too big or too small. Fix things properly, not minimally.
    45→
    46→Use `plan` to reorder priorities or cluster related issues. Rescan periodically. The scan
    47→output includes agent instructions — follow them, don't substitute your own analysis.
    48→```
    49→
    50→## From Vibe Coding to Vibe Engineering
    51→
    52→Vibe coding gets things built fast. But the codebases it produces tend to rot in ways that are hard to see and harder to fix — not just the mechanical stuff like dead imports, but the structural kind. Abstractions that made sense at first stop making sense. Naming drifts. Error handling is done three different ways. The codebase works, but working in it gets worse over time.
    53→
    54→LLMs are actually good at spotting this now, if you ask them the right questions. That's the core bet here — that an agent with the right framework can hold a codebase to a real standard, the kind that used to require a senior engineer paying close attention over months.
    55→
    56→So we're trying to define what "good" looks like as a score that's actually worth optimizing. Not a lint score you game to 100 by suppressing warnings. Something where improving the number means the codebase genuinely got better. That's hard, and we're not done, but the anti-gaming stuff matters to us a lot — it's the difference between a useful signal and a vanity metric.
    57→
    58→The hope is that anyone can use this to build something a seasoned engineer would look at and respect. That's the bar we're aiming for.
    59→
    60→If you'd like to join a community of vibe engineers who want to build beautiful things, [come hang out](https://discord.gg/aZdzbZrHaY).
    61→
    62→<img src="assets/engineering.png" width="100%">
    63→
    64→---
    65→
    66→Issues, improvements, and PRs are hugely appreciated — [github.com/peteromallet/desloppify](https://github.com/peteromallet/desloppify).
    67→

## Summary: Desloppify Dev Documentation & Test Data Spoofing

I've conducted a thorough search of the desloppify codebase and found comprehensive documentation and scripts for spoofing/faking data, testing stages, and understanding the workflow gates. Here are the key findings:

### 1. **Primary Interactive Testing Script**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/scripts/lifecycle_walkthrough.py`

This is the main tool for understanding the entire lifecycle and testing workflow gates:

- **Purpose**: Creates a temporary sandbox and walks through all 6 lifecycle stages interactively
- **Usage**: 
  ```bash
  python scripts/lifecycle_walkthrough.py
  ```
- **How it works**:
  - Writes spoofed state + plan files at each stage
  - Pauses and allows you to run real CLI commands in another terminal against the sandbox
  - Stages covered:
    1. Initial Reviews (fresh scan with placeholder dimensions)
    2. Reviews Complete (between scans)
    3. Post-scan: Workflow Items Injected (communicate-score + create-plan)
    4. Workflow Complete: Objective Work
    5. Review Issues: Triage Needed (triage stages injected)
    6. Triage Complete: Back to Work

- **Key features**:
  - Spoofs state with fake objective issues (complexity, naming, unused)
  - Creates fake review issues to trigger triage stages
  - Uses helper functions: `_placeholder_dim()`, `_scored_dim()`, `_apply_dims()`
  - Sets environment variable: `DESLOPPIFY_ROOT=<tmpdir>` for testing

### 2. **Programmatic Lifecycle Tests**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/tests/commands/test_lifecycle_transitions.py`

Integration tests that exercise all transitions programmatically:

- **Purpose**: Tests each transition between lifecycle phases
- **Key testing pattern**: `_spoof_reviews_complete(state)` — mutates state to simulate completed reviews
- **Helper functions**:
  - `_placeholder_dim_entries()` — creates unscored dimension entries
  - `_scored_dim_entries()` — creates scored dimension entries with real scores
  - `_build_state()` — constructs state with issues and dimensions
  - `_add_review_issues()` — adds review detector issues that trigger triage

- **Key concept**: Uses `purge_ids()` to complete items between reconcile calls, matching real CLI flow where reconcile only runs at scan boundaries

### 3. **Shared Test Fixtures & Helpers**

**Files**:
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/conftest.py` (core pytest fixtures)
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/tests/review/shared_review_fixtures.py`
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/tests/review/conftest.py`
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/tests/commands/test_helpers.py`

**Key fixtures for spoofing**:
- `set_project_root(tmp_path)` — sets project root to temp directory
- `empty_state()` — returns empty state structure
- `state_with_issues()` — returns state with pre-built test issues
- `mock_lang()` — creates mock language configuration
- `mock_lang_with_zones()` — mock language with zone mapping

**Test data builders in review tests**:
- `sample_issues_data()` — creates realistic review issues with evidence
- `_issue()` — builds individual issue objects with customizable detector, tier, confidence
- `_state()` — constructs state with issues and dimension scores

### 4. **State & Plan Schema Builders**

**Files**:
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_state/schema.py` (lines 322-339)
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/schema.py` (lines 166-187)

```python

```

These provide empty structures ready to be populated with fake data.

### 5. **Workflow Gate Detection**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/docs/DEVELOPMENT_PHILOSOPHY.md`

Documents the lifecycle phases and gates:

- **Phase 1**: Initial reviews — Unscored subjective dimensions (lifecycle blocks everything else until all placeholder dimensions are scored)
- **Phase 2**: Communicate score — `workflow::communicate-score` injected after initial reviews
- **Phase 3**: Create plan — `workflow::create-plan` injected when reviews complete
- **Phase 4**: Triage — 4 stages (`triage::observe` → `reflect` → `organize` → `commit`) injected when review-issue snapshot hash changes
- **Phase 5**: Objective work — Mechanical issues ranked by dimension impact

### 6. **Integration Test Patterns**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/tests/review/work_queue_cases.py`

Shows how to test work queue selection:

- `build_work_queue(state, **kwargs)` — builds queue from state
- `_issue()` helper — creates issues with customizable fields
- Pattern: `QueueBuildOptions` for controlling queue behavior

### 7. **CI/Roslyn Stub (Deterministic Testing)**

**File**: `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/.github/scripts/roslyn_stub.py`

Provides deterministic test payloads for CI:
- Emits Roslyn-like JSON for C# dependency graphs
- Used in integration tests with environment variable: `DESLOPPIFY_CSHARP_ROSLYN_CMD`

### 8. **Environment Variables for Testing**

Key env vars mentioned:
- `DESLOPPIFY_ROOT=<tmpdir>` — Override state/plan directory location
- `DESLOPPIFY_CSHARP_ROSLYN_CMD` — Override C# Roslyn command path

### Key Takeaways for Testing Triage/Workflow Gates

1. **To test gate transitions**: Use `lifecycle_walkthrough.py` interactively or `test_lifecycle_transitions.py` programmatically
2. **To spoof state**: Use `empty_state()` and populate with fake issues, dimensions, scores
3. **To spoof reviews**: Use `_placeholder_dim()` → `_scored_dim()` transition pattern
4. **To trigger triage**: Add review detector issues with `detail: {"dimension": "key"}` to state

```
     9→/**
    10→ * Edge function: get-task-status
    11→ *
    12→ * Returns the current status of a task by ID.
    13→ * Read-only, no side effects.
    14→ *
    15→ * POST /functions/v1/get-task-status
    16→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <service-key or PAT>
    17→ * Body: { "task_id": "uuid" }
    18→ *
    19→ * Returns:
    20→ * - 200 OK with { status }
    21→ * - 400 Bad Request if task_id missing
    22→ * - 404 Not Found if task doesn't exist
    23→ */
    24→serve(async (req) => {
    25→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
    26→  const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL");
    27→
    28→  if (!serviceKey || !supabaseUrl) {
    29→    return new Response("Server configuration error", { status: 500 });
    30→  }
    31→
    32→  const supabaseAdmin = createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);
    33→  const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, 'get-task-status');
    34→
    35→  if (req.method !== "POST") {
    36→    return new Response("Method not allowed", { status: 405 });
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  let requestBody: unknown = {};
    40→  try {
    41→    const bodyText = await req.text();
    42→    if (bodyText) {
    43→      requestBody = JSON.parse(bodyText);
    44→    }
    45→  } catch {
    46→    return new Response("Invalid JSON body", { status: 400 });
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  const taskId = requestBody.task_id;
    50→  if (!taskId) {
    51→    return new Response("task_id is required", { status: 400 });
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  const auth = await authenticateRequest(req, supabaseAdmin, "[GET-TASK-STATUS]");
    55→  if (!auth.success) {
    56→    return new Response(auth.error || "Authentication failed", { status: auth.statusCode || 403 });
    57→  }
    58→
    59→  try {
    60→    const { data: task, error } = await supabaseAdmin
    61→      .from("tasks")
    62→      .select("status")
    63→      .eq("id", taskId)
    64→      .single();
    65→
    66→    if (error || !task) {
    67→      return new Response("Task not found", { status: 404 });
    68→    }
    69→
    70→    return new Response(JSON.stringify({ status: task.status }), {
    71→      status: 200,
    72→      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    73→    });
    74→  } catch (error: unknown) {
    75→    logger.error('Internal server error', { task_id: taskId, error: error?.message });
    76→    await logger.flush();
    77→    return new Response(`Internal server error: ${error?.message}`, { status: 500 });
    78→  }
    79→});
```

```
     6→
     7→/**
     8→ * Edge function: get-task-output
     9→ *
    10→ * Fetches the output_location and status for a specific task.
    11→ * Used by workers to get outputs from dependency tasks (e.g., final_stitch getting transition outputs).
    12→ *
    13→ * - Service-role key: can fetch any task
    14→ * - User token: can only fetch tasks from their own projects
    15→ *
    16→ * POST /functions/v1/get-task-output
    17→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <service-key or PAT>
    18→ * Body: { "task_id": "uuid" }
    19→ *
    20→ * Returns:
    21→ * - 200 OK with { status, output_location }
    22→ * - 400 Bad Request if task_id missing
    23→ * - 401 Unauthorized if no valid token
    24→ * - 403 Forbidden if user doesn't own the task's project
    25→ * - 404 Not Found if task doesn't exist
    26→ * - 500 Internal Server Error
    27→ */
    28→serve((req) => withEdgeRequest(req, {
    29→  functionName: "get-task-output",
    30→  logPrefix: "[GET-TASK-OUTPUT]",
    31→  parseBody: "strict",
    32→  auth: {
    33→    required: true,
    34→  },
    35→}, async ({ supabaseAdmin, logger, body, auth }) => {
    36→  if (!auth || (!auth.userId && !auth.isServiceRole)) {
    37→    logger.error("Authentication failed");
    38→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Authentication failed" }, 401);
    39→  }
    40→
    41→  const taskId = typeof body.task_id === 'string' || typeof body.task_id === 'number'
    42→    ? String(body.task_id)
    43→    : '';
    44→  if (!taskId) {
    45→    logger.error("Missing task_id");
    46→    return jsonResponse({ error: "task_id is required" }, 400);
    47→  }
    48→
    49→  logger.setDefaultTaskId(taskId);
    50→
    51→  const actor = await authorizeTaskActor({
    52→    supabaseAdmin,
    53→    taskId,
    54→    auth: auth!,
    55→    logPrefix: "[GET-TASK-OUTPUT]",
    56→  });
    57→  if (!actor.ok) {
    58→    logger.error("Task access denied", {
    59→      task_id: taskId,
    60→      error: actor.error,
    61→      status_code: actor.statusCode,
    62→    });
    63→    return jsonResponse({ error: actor.error }, actor.statusCode);
    64→  }
    65→
    66→  // Fetch the task with all needed fields
    67→  const { data: task, error: taskError } = await supabaseAdmin
    68→    .from("tasks")
    69→    .select("id, status, output_location, project_id, params, dependant_on")
    70→    .eq("id", taskId)
    71→    .single();
    72→
    73→  if (taskError || !task) {
    74→    logger.error("Task not found", { error: taskError?.message });
    75→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Task not found" }, 404);
    76→  }
    77→
    78→  logger.info("Returning task output", { status: task.status, has_output: !!task.output_location });
    79→  return jsonResponse({
    80→    status: task.status,
    81→    output_location: task.output_location,
    82→    params: task.params,
    83→    dependant_on: task.dependant_on,
    84→  }, 200);
    85→}));
    86→
```

```
1→import type { SupabaseClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.39.7';
     2→import type { AuthResult } from './auth.ts';
     3→import { getTaskUserId, verifyTaskOwnership } from './auth.ts';
     4→
     5→interface TaskActorBaseInput {
     6→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient;
     7→  taskId: string;
     8→  auth: AuthResult;
     9→  logPrefix: string;
    10→}
    11→
    12→type TaskActorPolicyFailure = {
    13→  ok: false;
    14→  error: string;
    15→  statusCode: number;
    16→};
    17→
    18→type TaskActorPolicySuccess<T> = {
    19→  ok: true;
    20→  value: T;
    21→};
    22→
    23→type TaskActorPolicyResult<T> = TaskActorPolicySuccess<T> | TaskActorPolicyFailure;
    24→
    25→export interface AuthorizedTaskActor {
    26→  isServiceRole: boolean;
    27→  callerId: string | null;
    28→  taskOwnerVerified: boolean;
    29→}
    30→
    31→export async function authorizeTaskActor(
    32→  input: TaskActorBaseInput,
    33→): Promise<TaskActorPolicyResult<AuthorizedTaskActor>> {
    34→  const { supabaseAdmin, taskId, auth, logPrefix } = input;
    35→  if (auth.isServiceRole) {
    36→    return {
    37→      ok: true,
    38→      value: {
    39→        isServiceRole: true,
    40→        callerId: null,
    41→        taskOwnerVerified: false,
    42→      },
    43→    };
    44→  }
    45→
    46→  if (!auth.userId) {
    47→    return {
    48→      ok: false,
    49→      error: 'Authentication failed',
    50→      statusCode: 401,
    51→    };
    52→  }
    53→
    54→  const ownershipResult = await verifyTaskOwnership(
    55→    supabaseAdmin,
    56→    taskId,
    57→    auth.userId,
    58→    logPrefix,
    59→  );
    60→  if (!ownershipResult.success) {
    61→    return {
    62→      ok: false,
    63→      error: ownershipResult.error || 'Forbidden',
    64→      statusCode: ownershipResult.statusCode || 403,
    65→    };
    66→  }
    67→
    68→  return {
    69→    ok: true,
    70→    value: {
    71→      isServiceRole: false,
    72→      callerId: auth.userId,
    73→      taskOwnerVerified: true,
    74→    },
    75→  };
    76→}
    77→
    78→export interface ResolvedTaskStorageActor extends AuthorizedTaskActor {
    79→  taskUserId: string;
    80→}
    81→
    82→export async function resolveTaskStorageActor(
    83→  input: TaskActorBaseInput,
    84→): Promise<TaskActorPolicyResult<ResolvedTaskStorageActor>> {
    85→  const authorized = await authorizeTaskActor(input);
    86→  if (!authorized.ok) {
    87→    return authorized;
    88→  }
    89→
    90→  if (!authorized.value.isServiceRole) {
    91→    return {
    92→      ok: true,
    93→      value: {
    94→        ...authorized.value,
    95→        taskUserId: authorized.value.callerId!,
    96→      },
    97→    };
    98→  }
    99→
   100→  const taskUserResult = await getTaskUserId(
   101→    input.supabaseAdmin,
   102→    input.taskId,
   103→    input.logPrefix,
   104→  );
   105→  if (taskUserResult.error || !taskUserResult.userId) {
   106→    return {
   107→      ok: false,
   108→      error: taskUserResult.error || 'Task user resolution failed',
   109→      statusCode: taskUserResult.statusCode || 404,
   110→    };
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  return {
   114→    ok: true,
   115→    value: {
   116→      ...authorized.value,
   117→      taskUserId: taskUserResult.userId,
   118→    },
   119→  };
   120→}
   121→
```

```
    33→/**

    39→ * 3. JWT User Auth (optional) - Extract user ID from JWT payload.sub

    41→ * NOTE: We intentionally do NOT accept JWTs with service_role claims.
    42→ * Only the actual service key can be used for service role access.
    43→ * This prevents unsigned/forged JWTs from gaining elevated privileges.
    44→ *
    45→ * @param req - The incoming HTTP request
    46→ * @param supabaseAdmin - Supabase admin client for database queries
    47→ * @param logPrefix - Optional prefix for log messages (e.g., "[FUNCTION-NAME]")
    48→ * @param options - Optional settings for auth behavior
    49→ * @returns AuthResult with authentication details
    50→ */
    51→export async function authenticateRequest(
    52→  req: Request,
    53→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient,
    54→  logPrefix: string = "[AUTH]",
    55→  options: AuthOptions = {}
    56→): Promise<AuthResult> {
    57→  // Extract authorization header
    58→  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization");
    59→  if (!authHeader?.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
    60→    return {
    61→      isServiceRole: false,
    62→      userId: null,
    63→      success: false,
    64→      error: "Missing or invalid Authorization header",
    65→      statusCode: 401
    66→    };
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  const [REDACTED](7); // Remove "Bearer " prefix
    70→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
    71→
    72→  if (!serviceKey) {
    73→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY environment variable`);
    74→    return {
    75→      isServiceRole: false,
    76→      userId: null,
    77→      success: false,
    78→      error: "Server configuration error",
    79→      statusCode: 500
    80→    };
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  // 1) Check if token matches service-role key directly (SECURE)
    84→  if (token === serviceKey) {
    85→    return {
    86→      isServiceRole: true,
    87→      userId: null,
    88→      success: true
    89→    };
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  // 2) If JWT user auth is enabled, try to decode JWT and extract user ID
    93→  if (options.allowJwtUserAuth) {

    95→      const parts = token.split(".");

    97→        const payloadB64 = parts[1];
    98→        const padded = payloadB64 + "=".repeat((4 - payloadB64.length % 4) % 4);
    99→        const payload = JSON.parse(atob(padded));
   100→
   101→        // Check if this is a regular user JWT (not service role)

   106→            userId: payload.sub,
   107→            success: true,
   108→            isJwtAuth: true
   109→          };
   110→        }
   111→      }
   112→    } catch {

   114→    }
   115→  }

   117→  // 3) Personal Access Token (PAT) - look up in user_api_tokens table (SECURE)

   119→  const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
   120→    .from("user_api_tokens")
   121→    .select("user_id")
   122→    .eq("token", token)

   125→  if (error || !data) {

   127→    return {

   129→      userId: null,
   130→      success: false,
   131→      error: "Invalid or expired token",
   132→      statusCode: 403
   133→    };
   134→  }
   135→
   136→  const userId = data.user_id;
   137→  return {
   138→    isServiceRole: false,
   139→    userId,
   140→    success: true
```

```
1→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→
     3→type SettingsScopeIdentifier = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
     4→type SettingsScopeTableName = 'users' | 'projects' | 'shots';
     5→
     6→export function resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier): SettingsScopeTableName {
     7→  switch (scope) {
     8→    case 'user':
     9→      return 'users';
    10→    case 'project':
    11→      return 'projects';
    12→    case 'shot':
    13→      return 'shots';
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  throw new Error(`Invalid settings scope: ${String(scope)}`);
    17→}
    18→
    19→export function selectSettingsForScope(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier, id: string) {
    20→  const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    21→  return getSupabaseClient()
    22→    .from(tableName)
    23→    .select('settings')
    24→    .eq('id', id)
    25→    .single();
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function callUpdateToolSettingsAtomicRpc(
    29→  tableName: SettingsScopeTableName,
    30→  id: string,
    31→  toolId: string,
    32→  settings: Record<string, unknown>,
    33→) {
    34→  return getSupabaseClient().rpc('update_tool_settings_atomic', {
    35→    p_table_name: tableName,
    36→    p_id: id,
    37→    p_tool_id: toolId,
    38→    p_settings: settings,
    39→  });
    40→}
```

```
1→-- Include structure video settings in RPC output
     2→-- Structure video is stored under 'travel-structure-video' key, NOT under 'travel-between-images'
     3→-- This allows share pages to display the camera guidance video
     4→
     5→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_shared_shot_data(share_slug_param TEXT)
     6→RETURNS JSONB
     7→LANGUAGE plpgsql
     8→SECURITY DEFINER
     9→SET search_path = public
    10→AS $$
    11→DECLARE
    12→  share_record RECORD;
    13→  shot_record RECORD;
    14→  shot_generations_data JSONB;
    15→  segment_children_data JSONB;
    16→  all_generations JSONB;
    17→  shared_generation JSONB;
    18→  travel_settings JSONB;
    19→  structure_video_settings JSONB;
    20→BEGIN
    21→  -- 1. Get share record
    22→  SELECT
    23→    id, share_slug, generation_id, creator_id, view_count, shot_id,
    24→    cached_generation_data, creator_username, creator_name, creator_avatar_url
    25→  INTO share_record
    26→  FROM shared_generations
    27→  WHERE share_slug = share_slug_param;
    28→
    29→  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    30→    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Share not found');
    31→  END IF;
    32→
    33→  -- 2. Derive shot_id if not stored
    34→  IF share_record.shot_id IS NULL THEN
    35→    SELECT DISTINCT sg.shot_id INTO share_record.shot_id
    36→    FROM shot_generations sg
    37→    WHERE sg.generation_id = share_record.generation_id
    38→    LIMIT 1;
    39→  END IF;
    40→
    41→  IF share_record.shot_id IS NULL THEN
    42→    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Shot not found');
    43→  END IF;
    44→
    45→  -- 3. Get live shot data
    46→  SELECT id, name, settings
    47→  INTO shot_record
    48→  FROM shots
    49→  WHERE id = share_record.shot_id;
    50→
    51→  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    52→    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Shot has been deleted');
    53→  END IF;
    54→
    55→  -- 4. Get ALL shot_generations in GenerationRow format (same as mapShotGenerationToRow)
    56→  -- IMPORTANT: Include parent_generation_id for video parent/child detection
    57→  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
    58→    jsonb_build_object(
    59→      'id', sg.id,
    60→      'generation_id', g.id,
    61→      'shotImageEntryId', sg.id,
    62→      'shot_generation_id', sg.id,
    63→      'location', COALESCE(pv.location, g.location),
    64→      'imageUrl', COALESCE(pv.location, g.location),
    65→      'thumbUrl', COALESCE(pv.thumbnail_url, g.thumbnail_url, pv.location, g.location),
    66→      'type', COALESCE(g.type, 'image'),
    67→      'created_at', g.created_at,
    68→      'createdAt', g.created_at,
    69→      'starred', COALESCE(g.starred, false),
    70→      'name', g.name,
    71→      'based_on', g.based_on,
    72→      'params', COALESCE(g.params, '{}'::jsonb),
    73→      'parent_generation_id', g.parent_generation_id,
    74→      'child_order', g.child_order,
    75→      'pair_shot_generation_id', g.pair_shot_generation_id,
    76→      'timeline_frame', sg.timeline_frame,
    77→      'metadata', COALESCE(sg.metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
    78→      'position', CASE WHEN sg.timeline_frame IS NOT NULL THEN floor(sg.timeline_frame / 50) ELSE NULL END
    79→    ) ORDER BY sg.timeline_frame ASC NULLS LAST
    80→  ), '[]'::jsonb)
    81→  INTO shot_generations_data
    82→  FROM shot_generations sg
    83→  JOIN generations g ON sg.generation_id = g.id
    84→  LEFT JOIN generation_variants pv ON g.primary_variant_id = pv.id
    85→  WHERE sg.shot_id = share_record.shot_id;
    86→
    87→  -- 5. Get CHILDREN of parent video generations
    88→  -- Parent videos have type='video', no parent_generation_id, and either orchestrator_details or children
    89→  -- Children are segment videos with parent_generation_id pointing to a parent in shot_generations
    90→  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
    91→    jsonb_build_object(
    92→      'id', child.id,  -- Use child.id as both id and generation_id (no shot_generation entry)
    93→      'generation_id', child.id,
    94→      'shotImageEntryId', NULL,
    95→      'shot_generation_id', NULL,
    96→      'location', COALESCE(cpv.location, child.location),
    97→      'imageUrl', COALESCE(cpv.location, child.location),
    98→      'thumbUrl', COALESCE(cpv.thumbnail_url, child.thumbnail_url, cpv.location, child.location),
    99→      'type', COALESCE(child.type, 'video'),
   100→      'created_at', child.created_at,
   101→      'createdAt', child.created_at,
   102→      'starred', COALESCE(child.starred, false),
   103→      'name', child.name,
   104→      'based_on', child.based_on,
   105→      'params', COALESCE(child.params, '{}'::jsonb),
   106→      'parent_generation_id', child.parent_generation_id,
   107→      'child_order', child.child_order,
   108→      'pair_shot_generation_id', child.pair_shot_generation_id,
   109→      'timeline_frame', NULL,  -- Children don't have timeline positions
   110→      'metadata', '{}'::jsonb,
   111→      'position', NULL
   112→    ) ORDER BY child.child_order ASC NULLS LAST, child.created_at ASC
   113→  ), '[]'::jsonb)
   114→  INTO segment_children_data
   115→  FROM generations child
   116→  LEFT JOIN generation_variants cpv ON child.primary_variant_id = cpv.id
   117→  WHERE child.parent_generation_id IN (
   118→    -- Find all parent video generation IDs from shot_generations
   119→    SELECT g.id
   120→    FROM shot_generations sg
   121→    JOIN generations g ON sg.generation_id = g.id
   122→    WHERE sg.shot_id = share_record.shot_id
   123→      AND g.type = 'video'
   124→      AND g.parent_generation_id IS NULL
   125→  );
   126→
   127→  -- 6. Combine shot_generations + segment children
   128→  -- Use jsonb array concatenation
   129→  all_generations := shot_generations_data || segment_children_data;
   130→
   131→  -- 7. Get shared generation (the specific video being shared)
   132→  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
   133→    'id', g.id,
   134→    'location', g.location,
   135→    'thumbnail_url', g.thumbnail_url,
   136→    'type', g.type,
   137→    'created_at', g.created_at,
   138→    'name', g.name,
   139→    'params', g.params
   140→  )
   141→  INTO shared_generation
   142→  FROM generations g
   143→  WHERE g.id = share_record.generation_id;
   144→
   145→  IF shared_generation IS NULL THEN
   146→    shared_generation := share_record.cached_generation_data;
   147→  END IF;
   148→
   149→  -- 8. Get settings from both keys
   150→  -- Main travel settings
   151→  travel_settings := COALESCE(shot_record.settings->'travel-between-images', '{}'::jsonb);
   152→
   153→  -- Structure video settings (stored under separate [REDACTED])
   154→  structure_video_settings := shot_record.settings->'travel-structure-video';
   155→
   156→  -- Merge structure video into travel settings for frontend consumption
   157→  -- Include FULL array of structure_videos with all their settings (start_frame, end_frame, etc.)
   158→  -- Also provide legacy 'structureVideo' format for backwards compatibility
   159→  IF structure_video_settings IS NOT NULL AND structure_video_settings != 'null'::jsonb THEN
   160→    -- Check for new array format first
   161→    IF structure_video_settings->'structure_videos' IS NOT NULL
   162→       AND jsonb_array_length(structure_video_settings->'structure_videos') > 0 THEN
   163→      -- Include the full array of structure videos (for multi-video support)
   164→      travel_settings := travel_settings || jsonb_build_object(
   165→        'structureVideos', structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'
   166→      );
   167→      -- Also provide legacy format using first video for backwards compat
   168→      travel_settings := travel_settings || jsonb_build_object(
   169→        'structureVideo', jsonb_build_object(
   170→          'path', structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->>'path',
   171→          'metadata', structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->'metadata',
   172→          'treatment', COALESCE(structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->>'treatment', 'adjust'),
   173→          'motionStrength', COALESCE((structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->>'motion_strength')::numeric, 1.0),
   174→          'structureType', COALESCE(structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->>'structure_type', 'uni3c'),
   175→          'startFrame', COALESCE((structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->>'start_frame')::integer, 0),
   176→          'endFrame', (structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->>'end_frame')::integer
   177→        )
   178→      );
   179→    -- Legacy single-video format
   180→    ELSIF structure_video_settings->>'structure_video_path' IS NOT NULL THEN
   181→      travel_settings := travel_settings || jsonb_build_object(
   182→        'structureVideo', jsonb_build_object(
   183→          'path', structure_video_settings->>'structure_video_path',
   184→          'metadata', structure_video_settings->'metadata',
   185→          'treatment', COALESCE(structure_video_settings->>'structure_video_treatment', 'adjust'),
   186→          'motionStrength', COALESCE((structure_video_settings->>'structure_video_motion_strength')::numeric, 1.0),
   187→          'structureType', COALESCE(structure_video_settings->>'structure_video_type', 'uni3c')
   188→        )
   189→      );
   190→    -- Even older camelCase format
   191→    ELSIF structure_video_settings->>'path' IS NOT NULL THEN
   192→      travel_settings := travel_settings || jsonb_build_object(
   193→        'structureVideo', jsonb_build_object(
   194→          'path', structure_video_settings->>'path',
   195→          'metadata', structure_video_settings->'metadata',
   196→          'treatment', COALESCE(structure_video_settings->>'treatment', 'adjust'),
   197→          'motionStrength', COALESCE((structure_video_settings->>'motionStrength')::numeric, 1.0),
   198→          'structureType', COALESCE(structure_video_settings->>'structureType', 'uni3c')
   199→        )
   200→      );
   201→    END IF;
   202→  END IF;
   203→
   204→  -- 9. Return data
   205→  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
   206→    'shot_id', share_record.shot_id,
   207→    'shot_name', shot_record.name,
   208→    'generation', shared_generation,
   209→    'images', all_generations,
   210→    'settings', travel_settings,
   211→    'creator_id', share_record.creator_id,
   212→    'view_count', share_record.view_count,
   213→    'creator_username', share_record.creator_username,
   214→    'creator_name', share_record.creator_name,
   215→    'creator_avatar_url', share_record.creator_avatar_url
   216→  );
   217→END;
   218→$$;
   219→
```

```
1→-- Update RPC to include full structureVideos array with start_frame/end_frame
     2→-- This allows share pages to properly crop/position structure videos on the timeline
     3→
     4→CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_shared_shot_data(share_slug_param TEXT)
     5→RETURNS JSONB
     6→LANGUAGE plpgsql
     7→SECURITY DEFINER
     8→SET search_path = public
     9→AS $$
    10→DECLARE
    11→  share_record RECORD;
    12→  shot_record RECORD;
    13→  shot_generations_data JSONB;
    14→  segment_children_data JSONB;
    15→  all_generations JSONB;
    16→  shared_generation JSONB;
    17→  travel_settings JSONB;
    18→  structure_video_settings JSONB;
    19→BEGIN
    20→  -- 1. Get share record
    21→  SELECT
    22→    id, share_slug, generation_id, creator_id, view_count, shot_id,
    23→    cached_generation_data, creator_username, creator_name, creator_avatar_url
    24→  INTO share_record
    25→  FROM shared_generations
    26→  WHERE share_slug = share_slug_param;
    27→
    28→  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    29→    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Share not found');
    30→  END IF;
    31→
    32→  -- 2. Derive shot_id if not stored
    33→  IF share_record.shot_id IS NULL THEN
    34→    SELECT DISTINCT sg.shot_id INTO share_record.shot_id
    35→    FROM shot_generations sg
    36→    WHERE sg.generation_id = share_record.generation_id
    37→    LIMIT 1;
    38→  END IF;
    39→
    40→  IF share_record.shot_id IS NULL THEN
    41→    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Shot not found');
    42→  END IF;
    43→
    44→  -- 3. Get live shot data
    45→  SELECT id, name, settings
    46→  INTO shot_record
    47→  FROM shots
    48→  WHERE id = share_record.shot_id;
    49→
    50→  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    51→    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Shot has been deleted');
    52→  END IF;
    53→
    54→  -- 4. Get ALL shot_generations in GenerationRow format (same as mapShotGenerationToRow)
    55→  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
    56→    jsonb_build_object(
    57→      'id', sg.id,
    58→      'generation_id', g.id,
    59→      'shotImageEntryId', sg.id,
    60→      'shot_generation_id', sg.id,
    61→      'location', COALESCE(pv.location, g.location),
    62→      'imageUrl', COALESCE(pv.location, g.location),
    63→      'thumbUrl', COALESCE(pv.thumbnail_url, g.thumbnail_url, pv.location, g.location),
    64→      'type', COALESCE(g.type, 'image'),
    65→      'created_at', g.created_at,
    66→      'createdAt', g.created_at,
    67→      'starred', COALESCE(g.starred, false),
    68→      'name', g.name,
    69→      'based_on', g.based_on,
    70→      'params', COALESCE(g.params, '{}'::jsonb),
    71→      'parent_generation_id', g.parent_generation_id,
    72→      'child_order', g.child_order,
    73→      'pair_shot_generation_id', g.pair_shot_generation_id,
    74→      'timeline_frame', sg.timeline_frame,
    75→      'metadata', COALESCE(sg.metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
    76→      'position', CASE WHEN sg.timeline_frame IS NOT NULL THEN floor(sg.timeline_frame / 50) ELSE NULL END
    77→    ) ORDER BY sg.timeline_frame ASC NULLS LAST
    78→  ), '[]'::jsonb)
    79→  INTO shot_generations_data
    80→  FROM shot_generations sg
    81→  JOIN generations g ON sg.generation_id = g.id
    82→  LEFT JOIN generation_variants pv ON g.primary_variant_id = pv.id
    83→  WHERE sg.shot_id = share_record.shot_id;
    84→
    85→  -- 5. Get CHILDREN of parent video generations
    86→  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(
    87→    jsonb_build_object(
    88→      'id', child.id,
    89→      'generation_id', child.id,
    90→      'shotImageEntryId', NULL,
    91→      'shot_generation_id', NULL,
    92→      'location', COALESCE(cpv.location, child.location),
    93→      'imageUrl', COALESCE(cpv.location, child.location),
    94→      'thumbUrl', COALESCE(cpv.thumbnail_url, child.thumbnail_url, cpv.location, child.location),
    95→      'type', COALESCE(child.type, 'video'),
    96→      'created_at', child.created_at,
    97→      'createdAt', child.created_at,
    98→      'starred', COALESCE(child.starred, false),
    99→      'name', child.name,
   100→      'based_on', child.based_on,
   101→      'params', COALESCE(child.params, '{}'::jsonb),
   102→      'parent_generation_id', child.parent_generation_id,
   103→      'child_order', child.child_order,
   104→      'pair_shot_generation_id', child.pair_shot_generation_id,
   105→      'timeline_frame', NULL,
   106→      'metadata', '{}'::jsonb,
   107→      'position', NULL
   108→    ) ORDER BY child.child_order ASC NULLS LAST, child.created_at ASC
   109→  ), '[]'::jsonb)
   110→  INTO segment_children_data
   111→  FROM generations child
   112→  LEFT JOIN generation_variants cpv ON child.primary_variant_id = cpv.id
   113→  WHERE child.parent_generation_id IN (
   114→    SELECT g.id
   115→    FROM shot_generations sg
   116→    JOIN generations g ON sg.generation_id = g.id
   117→    WHERE sg.shot_id = share_record.shot_id
   118→      AND g.type = 'video'
   119→      AND g.parent_generation_id IS NULL
   120→  );
   121→
   122→  -- 6. Combine shot_generations + segment children
   123→  all_generations := shot_generations_data || segment_children_data;
   124→
   125→  -- 7. Get shared generation
   126→  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
   127→    'id', g.id,
   128→    'location', g.location,
   129→    'thumbnail_url', g.thumbnail_url,
   130→    'type', g.type,
   131→    'created_at', g.created_at,
   132→    'name', g.name,
   133→    'params', g.params
   134→  )
   135→  INTO shared_generation
   136→  FROM generations g
   137→  WHERE g.id = share_record.generation_id;
   138→
   139→  IF shared_generation IS NULL THEN
   140→    shared_generation := share_record.cached_generation_data;
   141→  END IF;
   142→
   143→  -- 8. Get settings from both keys
   144→  travel_settings := COALESCE(shot_record.settings->'travel-between-images', '{}'::jsonb);
   145→  structure_video_settings := shot_record.settings->'travel-structure-video';
   146→
   147→  -- Merge structure video into travel settings for frontend consumption
   148→  -- Include FULL array of structure_videos with all their settings (start_frame, end_frame, etc.)
   149→  IF structure_video_settings IS NOT NULL AND structure_video_settings != 'null'::jsonb THEN
   150→    -- Check for new array format first
   151→    IF structure_video_settings->'structure_videos' IS NOT NULL
   152→       AND jsonb_array_length(structure_video_settings->'structure_videos') > 0 THEN
   153→      -- Include the full array of structure videos (for multi-video support)
   154→      travel_settings := travel_settings || jsonb_build_object(
   155→        'structureVideos', structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'
   156→      );
   157→      -- Also provide legacy format using first video for backwards compat
   158→      travel_settings := travel_settings || jsonb_build_object(
   159→        'structureVideo', jsonb_build_object(
   160→          'path', structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->>'path',
   161→          'metadata', structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->'metadata',
   162→          'treatment', COALESCE(structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->>'treatment', 'adjust'),
   163→          'motionStrength', COALESCE((structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->>'motion_strength')::numeric, 1.0),
   164→          'structureType', COALESCE(structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->>'structure_type', 'uni3c'),
   165→          'startFrame', COALESCE((structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->>'start_frame')::integer, 0),
   166→          'endFrame', (structure_video_settings->'structure_videos'->0->>'end_frame')::integer
   167→        )
   168→      );
   169→    -- Legacy single-video format
   170→    ELSIF structure_video_settings->>'structure_video_path' IS NOT NULL THEN
   171→      travel_settings := travel_settings || jsonb_build_object(
   172→        'structureVideo', jsonb_build_object(
   173→          'path', structure_video_settings->>'structure_video_path',
   174→          'metadata', structure_video_settings->'metadata',
   175→          'treatment', COALESCE(structure_video_settings->>'structure_video_treatment', 'adjust'),
   176→          'motionStrength', COALESCE((structure_video_settings->>'structure_video_motion_strength')::numeric, 1.0),
   177→          'structureType', COALESCE(structure_video_settings->>'structure_video_type', 'uni3c')
   178→        )
   179→      );
   180→    -- Even older camelCase format
   181→    ELSIF structure_video_settings->>'path' IS NOT NULL THEN
   182→      travel_settings := travel_settings || jsonb_build_object(
   183→        'structureVideo', jsonb_build_object(
   184→          'path', structure_video_settings->>'path',
   185→          'metadata', structure_video_settings->'metadata',
   186→          'treatment', COALESCE(structure_video_settings->>'treatment', 'adjust'),
   187→          'motionStrength', COALESCE((structure_video_settings->>'motionStrength')::numeric, 1.0),
   188→          'structureType', COALESCE(structure_video_settings->>'structureType', 'uni3c')
   189→        )
   190→      );
   191→    END IF;
   192→  END IF;
   193→
   194→  -- 9. Return data
   195→  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
   196→    'shot_id', share_record.shot_id,
   197→    'shot_name', shot_record.name,
   198→    'generation', shared_generation,

   205→    'creator_avatar_url', share_record.creator_avatar_url
   206→  );
   207→END;
```

```
    30→function isLengthOneOrExpected(value: unknown, expected: number): boolean {

    38→function validatePairScopedArray(

    51→  if (isValid) {

    54→  const expectedText = allowSingleValueExpansion ? `1 or ${pairCount}` : `${pairCount}`;
    55→  throw new TaskValidationError(

    57→    field,

   122→/**
   123→ * Validates travel between images task parameters

   128→export function validateTravelBetweenImagesParams(params: TravelBetweenImagesTaskInput): void {

   144→  }
   145→

   147→    throw new TaskValidationError("segment_frames is required", 'segment_frames');
   148→  }
   149→

   151→    throw new TaskValidationError("frame_overlap is required", 'frame_overlap');
   152→  }

   155→  const pairCount = Math.max(1, imageCount - 1);
   156→
   157→  validatePairScopedArray('base_prompts', params.base_prompts, pairCount, 'base_prompts');
   158→  validatePairScopedArray('segment_frames', params.segment_frames, pairCount, 'segment_frames');
   159→  validatePairScopedArray('frame_overlap', params.frame_overlap, pairCount, 'frame_overlap');
   160→  validatePairScopedArray('negative_prompts', params.negative_prompts, pairCount, 'negative_prompts');
   161→  validatePairScopedArray('enhanced_prompts', params.enhanced_prompts, pairCount, 'enhanced_prompts');
   162→  validatePairScopedArray('pair_phase_configs', params.pair_phase_configs, pairCount, 'pair_phase_configs', false);
   163→  validatePairScopedArray('pair_loras', params.pair_loras, pairCount, 'pair_loras', false);
   164→  validatePairScopedArray('pair_motion_settings', params.pair_motion_settings, pairCount, 'pair_motion_settings', false);
   165→  validatePairScopedArray('pair_shot_generation_ids', params.pair_shot_generation_ids, pairCount, 'pair_shot_generation_ids', false);
   166→
   167→  validateImageScopedArray('image_generation_ids', params.image_generation_ids, imageCount, 'image_generation_ids');
   168→  validateImageScopedArray('image_variant_ids', params.image_variant_ids, imageCount, 'image_variant_ids');
   169→}
   170→
   171→/**
   172→ * Processes travel between images parameters and builds the orchestrator payload.
   173→ * This replicates the logic from the original steerable-motion edge function.
   174→ *
   175→ * @param params - Raw travel between images parameters
   176→ * @param finalResolution - Resolved resolution string (e.g. "1280x720")
   177→ * @param taskId - Orchestrator task ID for the payload
   178→ * @param runId - Run ID for grouping related tasks
   179→ * @param parentGenerationId - Parent generation ID to include in payload
   180→ * @returns Processed orchestrator payload
   181→ */
   182→export function buildTravelBetweenImagesPayload(
   183→  params: TravelBetweenImagesTaskInput,
   184→  finalResolution: string,
   185→  taskId: string,
   186→  runId: string,
   187→  parentGenerationId?: string,
   188→): Record<string, unknown> {
   189→  assertNoImplicitLegacyStructureFields(params);
   190→
   191→  // Calculate number of segments (matching original logic)
   192→  const numSegments = Math.max(1, params.image_urls.length - 1);
   193→
   194→  // Expand arrays if they have a single element and numSegments > 1
   195→  const basePromptsExpanded = expandArrayToCount(params.base_prompts, numSegments);
   196→  const negativePromptsExpanded = expandArrayToCount(params.negative_prompts, numSegments) || Array(numSegments).fill("");
   197→
   198→  // CRITICAL FIX: Only expand enhanced_prompts if they were actually provided OR if enhance_prompt is requested
   199→  // If enhance_prompt is true, we must provide an array (even if empty strings) for the backend to populate
   200→  const enhancedPromptsExpanded = params.enhanced_prompts
   201→    ? expandArrayToCount(params.enhanced_prompts, numSegments)
   202→    : (params.enhance_prompt ? Array(numSegments).fill("") : undefined);
   203→
   204→  const segmentFramesExpanded = expandArrayToCount(params.segment_frames, numSegments);
   205→  const frameOverlapExpanded = expandArrayToCount(params.frame_overlap, numSegments);
   206→
   207→  // Extract steps parameter - only needed if NOT in Advanced Mode
   208→  // In Advanced Mode, steps come from steps_per_phase in phase_config
   209→  let stepsValue = params.steps;
   210→  if (!params.advanced_mode) {
   211→    if (stepsValue === undefined && params.params_json_str) {
   212→      const parsedParams = toRecordOrEmpty(safeParseJson(params.params_json_str, {}));
   213→      const parsedSteps = asNumber(parsedParams.steps);
   214→      if (parsedSteps !== undefined) {
   215→        stepsValue = parsedSteps;
   216→      }
   217→    }
   218→    if (stepsValue === undefined) {
   219→      stepsValue = DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.steps;
   220→    }
   221→  }
   222→
   223→  // Handle random seed generation - if random_seed is true, generate a new random seed
   224→  // Otherwise use the provided seed or default
   225→  const finalSeed = resolveSeed32Bit({
   226→    seed: params.seed,
   227→    randomize: params.random_seed === true,
   228→    fallbackSeed: DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.seed,
   229→    field: 'seed',
   230→  });
   231→
   232→  // Build orchestrator payload matching the original edge function structure
   233→  const orchestratorPayload: Record<string, unknown> = {
   234→    // Common identifier for comparing batch vs individual segment generation
   235→    generation_source: 'batch',
   236→    orchestrator_task_id: taskId,
   237→    run_id: runId,
   238→    input_image_paths_resolved: params.image_urls,
   239→    // Include generation IDs for clickable images in SegmentCard
   240→    ...(params.image_generation_ids && params.image_generation_ids.length > 0
   241→      ? { input_image_generation_ids: params.image_generation_ids }
   242→      : {}),
   243→    // Include pair shot generation IDs for stable segment tethering
   244→    ...(params.pair_shot_generation_ids && params.pair_shot_generation_ids.length > 0
   245→      ? { pair_shot_generation_ids: params.pair_shot_generation_ids }
   246→      : {}),
   247→    num_new_segments_to_generate: numSegments,
   248→    base_prompts_expanded: basePromptsExpanded,
   249→    base_prompt: params.base_prompt, // Singular - the default/base prompt
   250→    negative_prompts_expanded: negativePromptsExpanded,
   251→    // CRITICAL FIX: Only include enhanced_prompts_expanded if actually provided
   252→    // This prevents the backend from misinterpreting empty arrays
   253→    ...(enhancedPromptsExpanded !== undefined ? { enhanced_prompts_expanded: enhancedPromptsExpanded } : {}),
   254→    // NEW: Per-pair parameter overrides (only include if there are actual overrides)
   255→    // Names must match backend expectations: phase_configs_expanded, loras_per_segment_expanded
   256→    // IMPORTANT: Truncate to numSegments to handle deleted images with stale arrays
   257→    ...(params.pair_phase_configs?.some(x => x !== null) ? { phase_configs_expanded: params.pair_phase_configs.slice(0, numSegments) } : {}),
   258→    ...(params.pair_loras?.some(x => x !== null) ? { loras_per_segment_expanded: params.pair_loras.slice(0, numSegments) } : {}),
   259→    ...(params.pair_motion_settings?.some(x => x !== null) ? { motion_settings_expanded: params.pair_motion_settings.slice(0, numSegments) } : {}),
   260→    segment_frames_expanded: segmentFramesExpanded,
   261→    frame_overlap_expanded: frameOverlapExpanded,
   262→    parsed_resolution_wh: finalResolution,
   263→    model_name: params.model_name ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.model_name,
   264→    model_type: params.model_type,
   265→    seed_base: finalSeed,
   266→    // Only include steps if NOT in Advanced Mode (Advanced Mode uses steps_per_phase)
   267→    ...(params.advanced_mode ? {} : { steps: stepsValue }),
   268→    after_first_post_generation_saturation: params.after_first_post_generation_saturation ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.after_first_post_generation_saturation,
   269→    after_first_post_generation_brightness: params.after_first_post_generation_brightness ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.after_first_post_generation_brightness,
   270→    debug_mode_enabled: params.debug ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.debug,
   271→    shot_id: params.shot_id,
   272→    // Include parent_generation_id so complete_task uses it instead of creating a new one
   273→    ...(parentGenerationId ? { parent_generation_id: parentGenerationId } : {}),
   274→    ...(params.main_output_dir_for_run
   275→      ? { main_output_dir_for_run: params.main_output_dir_for_run }
   276→      : {}),
   277→    enhance_prompt: params.enhance_prompt ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.enhance_prompt,
   278→    show_input_images: params.show_input_images ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.show_input_images,
   279→    generation_mode: params.generation_mode ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.generation_mode,
   280→    dimension_source: params.dimension_source ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.dimension_source,
   281→    // Only include amount_of_motion if NOT in Advanced Mode
   282→    ...(params.advanced_mode ? {} : { amount_of_motion: params.amount_of_motion ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.amount_of_motion }),
   283→    advanced_mode: params.advanced_mode ?? false,
   284→    // Always set regenerate_anchors to false in Advanced Mode
   285→    ...(params.advanced_mode ? { regenerate_anchors: false } : {}),
   286→    // Include generation_name in orchestrator payload so it flows to child tasks
   287→    generation_name: params.generation_name,
   288→    independent_segments: params.independent_segments ?? true,
   289→    // Text before/after prompts
   290→    ...(params.text_before_prompts ? { text_before_prompts: params.text_before_prompts } : {}),
   291→    ...(params.text_after_prompts ? { text_after_prompts: params.text_after_prompts } : {}),
   292→    // Motion control mode
   293→    ...(params.motion_mode ? { motion_mode: params.motion_mode } : {}),
   294→  };
   295→
   296→  const normalizedStructureGuidance = normalizeStructureGuidance({
   297→    structureGuidance: params.structure_guidance,
   298→    structureVideos: params.structure_videos,
   299→    defaultVideoTreatment: DEFAULT_VIDEO_STRUCTURE_PARAMS.structure_video_treatment,
   300→    defaultUni3cEndPercent: 0.1,
   301→  });
   302→  if (normalizedStructureGuidance) {
   303→    orchestratorPayload.structure_guidance = normalizedStructureGuidance;
   304→  }
   305→
   306→  const additionalLoras = buildAdditionalLorasRecord(params);
   307→  if (additionalLoras) {
   308→    orchestratorPayload.additional_loras = additionalLoras;
   309→  }
   310→
   311→  // Add phase_config if provided (for advanced mode)
   312→  if (params.phase_config) {
   313→    orchestratorPayload.phase_config = params.phase_config;
   314→  }
   315→
   316→  // Add selected_phase_preset_id if provided (for UI state restoration)
   317→  if (params.selected_phase_preset_id) {
   318→    orchestratorPayload.selected_phase_preset_id = params.selected_phase_preset_id;
   319→  }
   320→
   321→  const hasPairIds = Boolean(params.pair_shot_generation_ids?.length);
   322→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairIds
   323→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   324→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   325→
   326→  const travelReadContract: TravelBetweenImagesReadContract = {
   327→    contract_version: TASK_FAMILY_CONTRACT_VERSION,
   328→    prompt: params.base_prompt ?? params.base_prompts[0],
   329→    enhanced_prompt: enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[0],
   330→    negative_prompt: params.negative_prompts?.[0],
   331→    model_name: params.model_name ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.model_name,
   332→    resolution: finalResolution,
   333→    enhance_prompt: params.enhance_prompt ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.enhance_prompt,
   334→    motion_mode: params.motion_mode ?? 'basic',
   335→    selected_phase_preset_id: params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? null,
   336→    advanced_mode: params.advanced_mode ?? false,
   337→    amount_of_motion: params.amount_of_motion ?? DEFAULT_TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES_VALUES.amount_of_motion,
   338→    phase_config: params.phase_config,
   339→    additional_loras: additionalLoras,
   340→    segment_frames_expanded: segmentFramesExpanded,
   341→    frame_overlap_expanded: frameOverlapExpanded,
   342→    structure_guidance: normalizedStructureGuidance,
   343→  };
   344→
   345→  const familyContract = buildTravelBetweenImagesFamilyContract({
   346→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   347→    imageCount: params.image_urls.length,
   348→    segmentCount: numSegments,
   349→    hasPairIds,
   350→    readContract: travelReadContract,
   351→  });
   352→
   353→  return composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   354→    taskFamily: 'travel_between_images',
   355→    orchestratorDetails: orchestratorPayload,
   356→    orchestrationInput: {
   357→      taskFamily: 'travel_between_images',
   358→      orchestratorTaskId: taskId,
   359→      runId,
   360→      parentGenerationId,
   361→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   362→      generationRouting: 'orchestrator',
   363→      siblingLookup: 'run_id',
   364→    },
   365→    taskViewInput: {
   366→      inputImages: params.image_urls,
   367→      prompt: params.base_prompt ?? params.base_prompts[0],
   368→      negativePrompt: params.negative_prompts?.[0],
   369→      modelName: params.model_name,
   370→      resolution: finalResolution,
   371→    },
   372→    familyContract,
   373→  });
   374→}
```

```
   158→  guidance.preprocessing = STRUCTURE_PREPROCESSING_MAP[structureType] ?? 'flow';
   159→  const cannyIntensity = asNumber(input.structureVideoCannyIntensity);
   160→  const depthContrast = asNumber(input.structureVideoDepthContrast);
   161→  if (cannyIntensity !== undefined) {
   162→    guidance.canny_intensity = cannyIntensity;
   163→  }
   164→  if (depthContrast !== undefined) {
   165→    guidance.depth_contrast = depthContrast;
   166→  }
   167→  return guidance;
   168→}
   169→
   170→export function pickFirstStructureGuidance(...candidates: unknown[]): UnknownRecord | undefined {
   171→  for (const candidate of candidates) {
   172→    const parsed = asRecordOrUndefined(candidate);
   173→    if (parsed) {
   174→      return parsed;
   175→    }
   176→  }
   177→  return undefined;
   178→}
```

```
   454→  const update = useCallback(async (scope: SettingsScope, settings: Partial<T>): Promise<void> => {
   455→    // Snapshot the target entity id NOW to prevent cross-project/shot overwrites

   460→    // Using mutateAsync so callers can await the actual DB write completion.
   461→    // Use ref to access stable mutateAsync without recreating this callback.
   462→    await mutateAsyncRef.current({ scope, settings, entityId });
   463→  }, []); // Empty deps - all values accessed via refs for stability
   464→
   465→  return useMemo(() => ({
   466→    settings: settings as T | undefined,
   467→    isLoading,
   468→    error: error as Error | null,
   469→    update,
   470→    isUpdating: updateMutation.isPending,
```

```
     9→-- 20251016000001_add_missing_rls_policies.sql
    10→-- ============================================================================
    11→
    12→BEGIN;
    13→
    14→-- ============================================================================
    15→-- 1. TASK_TYPES TABLE - Enable RLS with read-only access
    16→-- ============================================================================
    17→-- The task_types table contains pricing configuration. Users need to READ
    18→-- this data (to see pricing) but should NEVER be able to modify it.
    19→-- Only service_role should be able to modify pricing.
    20→
    21→ALTER TABLE task_types ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
    22→
    23→-- Drop any existing policies
    24→DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "task_types_select_authenticated" ON task_types;
    25→DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "task_types_service_role_all" ON task_types;
    26→
    27→-- Policy: Authenticated users can only SELECT (read pricing data)
    28→CREATE POLICY "task_types_select_authenticated" ON task_types
    29→  FOR SELECT
    30→  TO authenticated
    31→  USING (true);
    32→
    33→-- Policy: Service role has full access (for admin operations)
    34→CREATE POLICY "task_types_service_role_all" ON task_types
    35→  FOR ALL
    36→  TO service_role
    37→  USING (true)
    38→  WITH CHECK (true);
    39→
    40→-- Note: No INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies for authenticated users
    41→-- This means they cannot modify the table at all
    42→
    43→COMMENT ON POLICY "task_types_select_authenticated" ON task_types IS
    44→  'Security: Users can read pricing data but cannot modify it';
    45→
    46→-- ============================================================================
    47→-- 2. SHOT_GENERATIONS RLS PERFORMANCE - Optimized index for ownership joins
    48→-- ============================================================================
    49→-- The RLS policy on shot_generations does:
    50→--   EXISTS (
    51→--     SELECT 1 FROM shots s
    52→--     JOIN projects p ON s.project_id = p.id
    53→--     WHERE s.id = shot_generations.shot_id
    54→--     AND p.user_id = auth.uid()
    55→--   )
    56→-- This requires efficient lookup from shot_id -> project_id -> user_id
    57→--
    58→-- We already have idx_shot_generations_shot_id_position, but let's add
    59→-- a covering index that includes just what the RLS check needs.
    60→
    61→-- Check if the index already exists before creating
    62→DO $$
    63→BEGIN
    64→  IF NOT EXISTS (
    65→    SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes
    66→    WHERE indexname = 'idx_shot_generations_rls_check'
    67→  ) THEN
    68→    CREATE INDEX idx_shot_generations_rls_check
    69→      ON shot_generations(shot_id);
    70→  END IF;
    71→END $$;
    72→
    73→-- Also ensure shots table has efficient project_id lookup for the join
    74→DO $$
    75→BEGIN
    76→  IF NOT EXISTS (
    77→    SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes
    78→    WHERE indexname = 'idx_shots_project_id_for_rls'
    79→  ) THEN
    80→    CREATE INDEX idx_shots_project_id_for_rls
    81→      ON shots(project_id, id);
    82→  END IF;
    83→END $$;
    84→
    85→-- And projects needs efficient user_id lookup
    86→DO $$
    87→BEGIN
    88→  IF NOT EXISTS (
    89→    SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes
    90→    WHERE indexname = 'idx_projects_user_id_for_rls'
    91→  ) THEN
    92→    CREATE INDEX idx_projects_user_id_for_rls
    93→      ON projects(user_id, id);
    94→  END IF;
    95→END $$;
    96→
    97→COMMENT ON INDEX idx_shot_generations_rls_check IS
    98→  'Optimizes RLS policy ownership check joins';
    99→COMMENT ON INDEX idx_shots_project_id_for_rls IS
   100→  'Optimizes RLS policy ownership check: shots -> projects join';
   101→COMMENT ON INDEX idx_projects_user_id_for_rls IS
   102→  'Optimizes RLS policy ownership check: projects -> user_id filter';
   103→
   104→-- ============================================================================
   105→-- 3. VERIFICATION
   106→-- ============================================================================
   107→-- Note: shared_generations INSERT policy was already fixed in
   108→-- 20251016000001_add_missing_rls_policies.sql to verify generation ownership
   109→
   110→DO $$
   111→DECLARE
   112→  task_types_rls boolean;
   113→BEGIN
   114→  -- Check RLS is enabled on task_types
   115→  SELECT relrowsecurity INTO task_types_rls
   116→  FROM pg_class WHERE relname = 'task_types';
   117→
   118→  IF NOT task_types_rls THEN
   119→    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CRITICAL: RLS not enabled on task_types table';
   120→  END IF;
   121→
   122→  RAISE NOTICE '✅ SECURITY AUDIT FIXES APPLIED:';
   123→  RAISE NOTICE '   - task_types: RLS enabled, read-only for users';
   124→  RAISE NOTICE '   - RLS join indexes added for shot_generations, shots, and projects';
   125→END $$;
   126→
   127→COMMIT;
   128→
```

```
    64→const VideoResourceItem: React.FC<ResourceItemProps> = ({

    84→      onClick={onClick}
    85→    >
    86→      <div className="aspect-square relative">
    87→        {!isLoaded && (

    93→        <HoverScrubVideo

    98→          preload="metadata"
    99→          onLoadedData={onLoaded}
   100→          onVideoError={onLoaded}

   103→        {isProcessing && (

   109→        <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 flex items-center justify-between px-2 py-1.5 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-10">
   110→          {durationInfo ? <span className="text-xs text-white/90">{durationInfo}</span> : <div />}
   111→          {isOwner && onToggleVisibility ? (

   165→
   166→        {isOwner && (

   168→            <span className="text-xs text-white/90">Mine</span>
   169→            {onToggleVisibility ? (

   181→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   182→// Grid component
   183→// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   184→
   185→interface ResourceBrowserGridProps {
   186→  browsing: ResourceBrowserData;
   187→  resourceLabelPlural: string;
   188→}
   189→
   190→export const ResourceBrowserGrid: React.FC<ResourceBrowserGridProps> = ({
   191→  browsing,
   192→  resourceLabelPlural,
   193→}) => {
   194→  if (browsing.loading) {
   195→    return (
   196→      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
   197→        {Array.from({ length: 16 }).map((_, index) => (
   198→          <div
   199→            key={`skeleton-${index}`}
   200→            className="relative rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 border-transparent"
   201→          >
   202→            <div className="aspect-square bg-gradient-to-br from-muted via-muted/50 to-muted animate-pulse relative">
   203→              <SkeletonShimmer />
   204→            </div>
   205→          </div>
   206→        ))}
   207→      </div>
   208→    );
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  if (browsing.paginatedResources.length === 0) {
   212→    return (
   213→      <div className="text-center py-12">
   214→        {browsing.isVideoMode ? (
   215→          <Video className="h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
   216→        ) : (
   217→          <ImageIcon className="h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-4" />
   218→        )}
   219→        <p className="text-muted-foreground">
   220→          {browsing.filteredResources.length === 0
   221→            ? browsing.showMyResourcesOnly
   222→              ? `You don't have any ${resourceLabelPlural} yet`
   223→              : `No ${resourceLabelPlural} found`
   224→            : 'No results on this page'}
   225→        </p>
   226→        {browsing.searchTerm && (
   227→          <div className="mt-2">
   228→            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={browsing.clearSearch}>
   229→              Clear search to see all {resourceLabelPlural}
   230→            </Button>
   231→          </div>
   232→        )}
   233→        {browsing.showMyResourcesOnly && (
   234→          <div>
   235→            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={browsing.clearMyResourcesFilter}>
   236→              Show all {resourceLabelPlural}
   237→            </Button>
   238→          </div>
   239→        )}
   240→      </div>
   241→    );
   242→  }
   243→
   244→  return (
   245→    <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
   246→      {browsing.paginatedResources.map((resource) => {
   247→        const legacyOwnerId =
   248→          'user_id' in resource && typeof resource.user_id === 'string' ? resource.user_id : undefined;
   249→        const resourceOwnerId = resource.userId || legacyOwnerId;
   250→        const isOwner = browsing.userId && resourceOwnerId === browsing.userId;
   251→
   252→        const commonProps = {
   253→          resource,
   254→          isOwner: !!isOwner,
   255→          isProcessing: browsing.processingResource === resource.id,
   256→          isLoaded: browsing.isThumbnailLoaded(resource.id),
   257→          onLoaded: () => browsing.markThumbnailLoaded(resource.id),
   258→          onClick: () => {
   259→            void browsing.handleResourceClick(resource);
   260→          },
   261→          onToggleVisibility: isOwner ? browsing.handleToggleVisibility : undefined,
   262→        };
   263→
   264→        if (browsing.isVideoMode) {
   265→          return <VideoResourceItem key={resource.id} {...commonProps} />;
   266→        }
   267→
   268→        return <ImageResourceItem key={resource.id} {...commonProps} />;
   269→      })}
   270→    </div>
   271→  );
   272→};
   273→
```
