```
   443→def _sorted_clusters_by_queue_pos(
   444→    clusters: dict, queue_order: list[str],
   445→) -> tuple[list[tuple[str, dict]], dict[str, int]]:
   446→    """Sort clusters by their earliest member's position in the queue.
   447→
   448→    Returns (sorted_cluster_pairs, min_pos_cache) where min_pos_cache maps
   449→    cluster name to its earliest queue position (999_999 if no members queued).
   450→    """
   451→    pos_map = {fid: i for i, fid in enumerate(queue_order)}
   452→
   453→    def _min_pos(cluster_data: dict) -> int:
   454→        positions = [pos_map[fid] for fid in cluster_data.get("issue_ids", []) if fid in pos_map]
   455→        return min(positions) if positions else 999_999
   456→
   457→    min_pos_cache = {name: _min_pos(c) for name, c in clusters.items()}
   458→    sorted_clusters = sorted(clusters.items(), key=lambda kv: min_pos_cache[kv[0]])
   459→    return sorted_clusters, min_pos_cache
   460→
   461→
   462→def _print_cluster_list_verbose(
   463→    sorted_clusters: list[tuple[str, dict]],
   464→    min_pos_cache: dict[str, int],
   465→    active: str | None,
   466→) -> None:
   467→    """Print the verbose table view of the cluster list."""
   468→    name_width = max(20, min(35, max(len(n) for n, _ in sorted_clusters)))
   469→    total = len(sorted_clusters)
   470→    print(colorize(f"  Clusters ({total} total, sorted by queue position):", "bold"))
   471→    print()
   472→    header = f"  {'#pos':<5}  {'Name':<{name_width}}  {'Items':>5}  {'Steps':>5}  {'Type':<6}  Description"
   473→    sep = f"  {'─'*4}  {'─'*name_width}  {'─'*5}  {'─'*5}  {'─'*6}  {'─'*45}"
   474→    print(colorize(header, "dim"))
   475→    print(colorize(sep, "dim"))
   476→    for name, cluster in sorted_clusters:
   477→        min_p = min_pos_cache[name]
   478→        pos_str = f"#{min_p}" if min_p < 999_999 else "—"
   479→        member_count = len(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   480→        steps = cluster.get("action_steps") or []
   481→        steps_str = str(len(steps)) if steps else "—"
   482→        type_str = "auto" if cluster.get("auto") else "manual"
   483→        desc = cluster.get("description") or ""
   484→        if not desc and min_p == 999_999 and not member_count:
   485→            desc = "(no queue position — no members)"
   486→        desc_truncated = (desc[:44] + "…") if len(desc) > 45 else desc
   487→        name_display = (name[:name_width - 1] + "…") if len(name) > name_width else name
   488→        focused = " *" if name == active else ""
   489→        print(f"  {pos_str:>5}  {name_display:<{name_width}}  {member_count:>5}  {steps_str:>5}  {type_str:<6}  {desc_truncated}{focused}")
   490→    print()
   491→
   492→
   493→def _cmd_cluster_list(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   494→    plan = load_plan()
   495→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   496→    active = plan.get("active_cluster")
   497→    verbose: bool = getattr(args, "verbose", False)
   498→
   499→    if not clusters:
   500→        print("  No clusters defined.")
   501→        return
   502→
   503→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   504→    sorted_clusters, min_pos_cache = _sorted_clusters_by_queue_pos(clusters, queue_order)
   505→
   506→    if verbose:
   507→        _print_cluster_list_verbose(sorted_clusters, min_pos_cache, active)
   508→        return
   509→
   510→    print(colorize("  Clusters (ordered by queue position):", "bold"))
   511→    for name, cluster in sorted_clusters:
   512→        min_p = min_pos_cache[name]
   513→        pos_str = f"#{min_p}" if min_p < 999_999 else "—"
   514→        member_count = len(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   515→        desc = cluster.get("description") or ""
   516→        marker = " (focused)" if name == active else ""
   517→        desc_str = f" — {desc}" if desc else ""
   518→        auto_tag = " [auto]" if cluster.get("auto") else ""
   519→        print(f"    {pos_str:>5}  {name}: {member_count} items{auto_tag}{desc_str}{marker}")
   520→
   521→
   522→def _cmd_cluster_update(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   523→    """Update cluster description and/or action_steps."""
   524→    cluster_name: str = getattr(args, "cluster_name", "")
   525→    description: str | None = getattr(args, "description", None)
   526→    steps: list[str] | None = getattr(args, "steps", None)
   527→
   528→    if description is None and steps is None:
   529→        print(colorize("  Nothing to update. Use --description and/or --steps.", "yellow"))
   530→        return
   531→
   532→    plan = load_plan()
   533→    cluster = plan.get("clusters", {}).get(cluster_name)
   534→    if cluster is None:
   535→        print(colorize(f"  Cluster {cluster_name!r} does not exist.", "red"))
   536→        return
   537→
   538→    if description is not None:
   539→        cluster["description"] = description
   540→    if steps is not None:
   541→        cluster["action_steps"] = list(steps)
   542→        print(colorize(f"  Stored {len(steps)} action step(s):", "dim"))
   543→        for i, step in enumerate(steps, 1):
   544→            clean = _LEADING_NUM_RE.sub('', step)
   545→            print(colorize(f"    {i}. {clean}", "dim"))
   546→        if len(steps) == 0:
   547→            print(colorize("  Warning: 0 steps stored. Did you forget the --steps values?", "yellow"))
   548→        elif len(steps) == 1 and len(steps[0]) > 100:
   549→            print(colorize("  Warning: only 1 step stored and it's quite long. Check shell quoting.", "yellow"))
   550→    cluster["user_modified"] = True
   551→    cluster["updated_at"] = utc_now()
   552→    append_log_entry(
   553→        plan, "cluster_update", cluster_name=cluster_name, actor="user",
   554→        detail={"description": description, "steps": steps},
   555→    )
   556→    save_plan(plan)
   557→    print(colorize(f"  Updated cluster: {cluster_name}", "green"))
   558→
   559→
   560→def _cmd_cluster_merge(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   561→    """Merge source cluster into target cluster."""
   562→    source: str = getattr(args, "source", "")
   563→    target: str = getattr(args, "target", "")
   564→
   565→    plan = load_plan()
   566→    try:
   567→        added, source_ids = merge_clusters(plan, source, target)
   568→    except ValueError as ex:
   569→        print(colorize(f"  {ex}", "red"))
   570→        return
   571→
   572→    append_log_entry(
   573→        plan, "cluster_merge", issue_ids=source_ids,
   574→        cluster_name=target, actor="user",
   575→        detail={"source": source, "added": added},
   576→    )
   577→    save_plan(plan)
   578→    print(colorize(
   579→        f"  Merged cluster {source!r} into {target!r}: "
   580→        f"{added} issue(s) added, {len(source_ids)} total moved. Source deleted.",
   581→        "green",
   582→    ))
   583→
   584→
   585→def cmd_cluster_dispatch(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   586→    """Route cluster subcommands."""
   587→    cluster_action = getattr(args, "cluster_action", None)
   588→    dispatch = {
   589→        "create": _cmd_cluster_create,
   590→        "add": _cmd_cluster_add,
   591→        "remove": _cmd_cluster_remove,
   592→        "delete": _cmd_cluster_delete,
   593→        "reorder": _cmd_cluster_reorder,
   594→        "show": _cmd_cluster_show,
   595→        "list": _cmd_cluster_list,
   596→        "update": _cmd_cluster_update,
   597→        "merge": _cmd_cluster_merge,
   598→    }
   599→    handler = dispatch.get(cluster_action)
   600→    if handler is None:
   601→        _cmd_cluster_list(args)
   602→        return
   603→    handler(args)
```

```
1→"""Cluster mutations for plan operations."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from desloppify.engine._plan.operations_queue import move_items
     6→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import Cluster, PlanModel, ensure_plan_defaults
     7→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import utc_now
     8→
     9→
    10→def create_cluster(
    11→    plan: PlanModel,
    12→    name: str,
    13→    description: str | None = None,
    14→    action: str | None = None,
    15→) -> Cluster:
    16→    """Create a named cluster. Raises ValueError if it already exists."""
    17→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
    18→    if name.startswith("auto/"):
    19→        raise ValueError(
    20→            f"Cluster names starting with 'auto/' are reserved for auto-clusters: {name!r}"
    21→        )
    22→    if name.startswith("epic/"):
    23→        raise ValueError(
    24→            f"Cluster names starting with 'epic/' are reserved for triage epics: {name!r}"
    25→        )
    26→    if name in plan["clusters"]:
    27→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {name!r} already exists")
    28→    now = utc_now()
    29→    cluster: Cluster = {
    30→        "name": name,
    31→        "description": description,
    32→        "issue_ids": [],
    33→        "created_at": now,
    34→        "updated_at": now,
    35→        "auto": False,
    36→        "cluster_key": "",
    37→        "action": action,
    38→        "user_modified": False,
    39→    }
    40→    plan["clusters"][name] = cluster
    41→    return cluster
    42→
    43→
    44→def add_to_cluster(
    45→    plan: PlanModel, cluster_name: str, issue_ids: list[str]
    46→) -> int:
    47→    """Add issue IDs to a cluster. Returns count added."""
    48→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
    49→    cluster = plan["clusters"].get(cluster_name)
    50→    if cluster is None:
    51→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {cluster_name!r} does not exist")
    52→
    53→    member_ids: list[str] = cluster["issue_ids"]
    54→    count = 0
    55→    now = utc_now()
    56→    for fid in issue_ids:
    57→        if fid not in member_ids:
    58→            member_ids.append(fid)
    59→            count += 1
    60→        overrides = plan["overrides"]
    61→        if fid not in overrides:
    62→            overrides[fid] = {"issue_id": fid, "created_at": now}
    63→        overrides[fid]["cluster"] = cluster_name
    64→        overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now
    65→
    66→    cluster["updated_at"] = now
    67→    return count
    68→
    69→
    70→def remove_from_cluster(
    71→    plan: PlanModel, cluster_name: str, issue_ids: list[str]
    72→) -> int:
    73→    """Remove issue IDs from a cluster. Returns count removed."""
    74→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
    75→    cluster = plan["clusters"].get(cluster_name)
    76→    if cluster is None:
    77→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {cluster_name!r} does not exist")
    78→
    79→    member_ids: list[str] = cluster["issue_ids"]
    80→    now = utc_now()
    81→    count = 0
    82→    for fid in issue_ids:
    83→        if fid in member_ids:
    84→            member_ids.remove(fid)
    85→            count += 1
    86→        override = plan["overrides"].get(fid)
    87→        if override and override.get("cluster") == cluster_name:
    88→            override["cluster"] = None
    89→            override["updated_at"] = now
    90→
    91→    if count > 0 and cluster.get("auto"):
    92→        cluster["user_modified"] = True
    93→
    94→    cluster["updated_at"] = now
    95→    return count
    96→
    97→
    98→def delete_cluster(plan: PlanModel, name: str) -> list[str]:
    99→    """Delete a cluster and clear cluster refs from overrides. Returns orphaned IDs."""
   100→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   101→    cluster = plan["clusters"].pop(name, None)
   102→    if cluster is None:
   103→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {name!r} does not exist")
   104→
   105→    orphaned = list(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   106→    now = utc_now()
   107→    for fid in orphaned:
   108→        override = plan["overrides"].get(fid)
   109→        if override and override.get("cluster") == name:
   110→            override["cluster"] = None
   111→            override["updated_at"] = now
   112→
   113→    if plan.get("active_cluster") == name:
   114→        plan["active_cluster"] = None
   115→
   116→    return orphaned
   117→
   118→
   119→def merge_clusters(
   120→    plan: PlanModel, source_name: str, target_name: str
   121→) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
   122→    """Move all source issues to target, copy missing metadata, delete source."""
   123→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   124→    if source_name == target_name:
   125→        raise ValueError("Cannot merge a cluster into itself")
   126→    source = plan["clusters"].get(source_name)
   127→    if source is None:
   128→        raise ValueError(f"Source cluster {source_name!r} does not exist")
   129→    target = plan["clusters"].get(target_name)
   130→    if target is None:
   131→        raise ValueError(f"Target cluster {target_name!r} does not exist")
   132→
   133→    source_ids = list(source.get("issue_ids", []))
   134→    target_ids: list[str] = target["issue_ids"]
   135→    now = utc_now()
   136→
   137→    existing = set(target_ids)
   138→    added = 0
   139→    for fid in source_ids:
   140→        if fid not in existing:
   141→            target_ids.append(fid)
   142→            existing.add(fid)
   143→            added += 1
   144→        overrides = plan["overrides"]
   145→        if fid not in overrides:
   146→            overrides[fid] = {"issue_id": fid, "created_at": now}
   147→        overrides[fid]["cluster"] = target_name
   148→        overrides[fid]["updated_at"] = now
   149→
   150→    if not target.get("description") and source.get("description"):
   151→        target["description"] = source["description"]
   152→    if not target.get("action_steps") and source.get("action_steps"):
   153→        target["action_steps"] = list(source["action_steps"])
   154→    if not target.get("action") and source.get("action"):
   155→        target["action"] = source["action"]
   156→
   157→    target["updated_at"] = now
   158→
   159→    plan["clusters"].pop(source_name, None)
   160→    if plan.get("active_cluster") == source_name:
   161→        plan["active_cluster"] = None
   162→
   163→    return added, source_ids
   164→
   165→
   166→def move_cluster(
   167→    plan: PlanModel,
   168→    cluster_name: str,
   169→    position: str,
   170→    target: str | None = None,
   171→    offset: int | None = None,
   172→) -> int:
   173→    """Move all cluster members as a contiguous block. Returns count moved."""
   174→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   175→    cluster = plan["clusters"].get(cluster_name)
   176→    if cluster is None:
   177→        raise ValueError(f"Cluster {cluster_name!r} does not exist")
   178→
   179→    member_ids = list(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   180→    if not member_ids:
   181→        return 0
   182→
   183→    return move_items(plan, member_ids, position, target, offset)
   184→
   185→
   186→__all__ = [
   187→    "add_to_cluster",
   188→    "create_cluster",
   189→    "delete_cluster",
   190→    "merge_clusters",
   191→    "move_cluster",
   192→    "remove_from_cluster",
   193→]
   194→
```

```
   342→def add_plan_parser(sub) -> None:
   343→    p_plan = sub.add_parser(
   344→        "plan",
   345→        help="Living plan: generate, show, resolve, skip, cluster, triage",
   346→        description="""\
   347→Manage the living plan — a persistent layer on top of the work queue.
   348→Track custom ordering, clusters, skips, and per-issue annotations.
   349→Run with no subcommand to generate a full prioritized markdown plan.""",
   350→        epilog="""\
   351→typical workflow:
   352→  desloppify scan                       # detect issues
   353→  desloppify plan                       # full prioritized markdown
   354→  desloppify plan queue                 # compact table of all items
   355→  desloppify plan cluster create ...    # group related issues
   356→  desloppify plan focus <cluster>       # narrow scope
   357→  desloppify next                       # work on the next item
   358→  desloppify plan resolve <id> --attest .. # mark as fixed
   359→
   360→patterns (used by reorder, skip, resolve, describe, note, etc.):
   361→  Patterns match issues by detector, file, ID prefix, glob, or name.
   362→  Cluster names also work as patterns — they expand to all member IDs.
   363→  Examples: "security", "src/foo.py", "unused::*React*", "my-cluster"
   364→
   365→subcommands:
   366→  show       Show plan metadata summary
   367→  queue      Compact table of upcoming queue items
   368→  reset      Reset plan to empty
   369→  reorder    Reposition issues or clusters in the queue
   370→  resolve    Mark issues as fixed (score movement + next-step)
   371→  describe   Set augmented description
   372→  note       Set note on issues
   373→  skip       Skip issues (temporary/permanent/false_positive)
   374→  unskip     Bring skipped issues back to queue
   375→  reopen     Reopen resolved issues
   376→  focus      Set or clear active cluster focus
   377→  cluster    Manage issue clusters
   378→  triage     Staged triage workflow (after review)
   379→  scan-gate  Check or skip scan requirement for workflow items""",
   380→        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
   381→    )
   382→    p_plan.add_argument("--state", type=str, default=None, help="Path to state file")
   383→    p_plan.add_argument(
   384→        "--output", type=str, metavar="FILE",
   385→        help="Write to file instead of stdout (refuses to overwrite existing files)",
   386→    )
   387→
   388→    plan_sub = p_plan.add_subparsers(dest="plan_action")
   389→
   390→    # plan show
   391→    plan_sub.add_parser("show", help="Show plan metadata summary")
   392→
   393→    _add_queue_subparser(plan_sub)
```

```
   168→def cmd_plan_queue(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   169→    """Render a compact table of all upcoming queue items."""
   170→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   171→    state = runtime.state
   172→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
   173→        return
   174→
   175→    top = getattr(args, "top", 30)
   176→    cluster_filter = getattr(args, "cluster", None)
   177→    include_skipped = bool(getattr(args, "include_skipped", False))
   178→
   179→    plan = load_plan()
   180→    print_triage_guardrail_info(plan=plan, state=state)
   181→
   182→    effective_cluster = cluster_filter
   183→    if not cluster_filter:
   184→        active_cluster = plan.get("active_cluster")
   185→        if active_cluster:
   186→            effective_cluster = active_cluster
   187→
   188→    queue = build_work_queue(
   189→        state,
   190→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   191→            count=None,
   192→            status="open",
   193→            include_subjective=True,
   194→            plan=plan,
   195→            include_skipped=include_skipped,
   196→            cluster=effective_cluster,
   197→        ),
   198→    )
   199→    items = queue.get("items", [])
   200→    # Collapse auto-clusters into display meta-items
   201→    if plan and not effective_cluster and not plan.get("active_cluster"):
   202→        items = collapse_clusters(items, plan)
   203→
   204→    sort_by = getattr(args, "sort", "priority")
   205→    all_new_ids: set[str] = queue.get("new_ids", set())
   206→    # Merge review-based new issue IDs (since last triage)
   207→    review_new_ids = compute_new_issue_ids(plan, state)
   208→    all_new_ids = all_new_ids | review_new_ids
   209→    item_ids = {it.get("id") for it in items}
   210→    new_ids = all_new_ids & item_ids
   211→
   212→    if sort_by == "recent":
   213→        items = sorted(items, key=lambda it: it.get("first_seen", ""), reverse=True)
   214→
   215→    _print_queue_header(
   216→        items=items,
   217→        include_skipped=include_skipped,
   218→        plan=plan,
   219→        new_count=len(new_ids),
   220→    )
   221→
   222→    if not items:
   223→        print(colorize("\n  Queue is empty.", "green"))
   224→        return
   225→
   226→    # Determine which items to show
   227→    display_items = _queue_display_items(items, top=top)
   228→
   229→    # Render cluster banners first, then remaining items in the table
   230→    print()
   231→    for idx, item in enumerate(display_items, 1):
   232→        if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
   233→            _render_cluster_banner(item, idx, new_ids)
   234→
   235→    rows = _build_rows(display_items, new_ids=new_ids)
   236→    if rows:

   238→        widths = [4, 4, 12, 50, 16]
   239→        print_table(headers, rows, widths=widths)

   241→    if top > 0 and len(items) > top:
```

```
   190→def ensure_plan_defaults(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   191→    """Normalize a loaded plan to ensure all keys exist.
   192→
   193→    Runtime contract is v7-only. Legacy payloads are upgraded in-place once.
   194→    """
   195→    defaults = empty_plan()
   196→    for key, value in defaults.items():

   198→    _upgrade_plan_to_v7(plan)

   201→def triage_clusters(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Cluster]:
   202→    """Return clusters whose name starts with ``EPIC_PREFIX``."""
   203→    return {
   204→        name: cluster
   205→        for name, cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).items()
   206→        if name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX)
   207→    }
   208→
   209→
   210→def validate_plan(plan: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
   211→    """Raise ValueError when plan invariants are violated."""
   212→    if not isinstance(plan.get("version"), int):
   213→        raise ValueError("plan.version must be an int")
   214→    if not isinstance(plan.get("queue_order"), list):
   215→        raise ValueError("plan.queue_order must be a list")
   216→
   217→    # No ID should appear in both queue_order and skipped
   218→    skipped_ids = set(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   219→    overlap = set(plan["queue_order"]) & skipped_ids
   220→    if overlap:
   221→        raise ValueError(
   222→            f"IDs cannot appear in both queue_order and skipped: {sorted(overlap)}"
   223→        )
   224→
   225→    # Validate skip entry kinds
   226→    for fid, entry in plan.get("skipped", {}).items():
   227→        kind = entry.get("kind")
   228→        if kind not in VALID_SKIP_KINDS:
   229→            raise ValueError(
   230→                f"Invalid skip kind {kind!r} for {fid}; must be one of {sorted(VALID_SKIP_KINDS)}"
   231→            )
   232→
```

```
   125→    _build_and_render_queue(args, state, config)
   126→
   127→
   128→def _resolve_cluster_focus(
   129→    plan_data: dict | None,
   130→    *,
   131→    cluster_arg: str | None,
   132→    scope: str | None,
   133→) -> str | None:
   134→    effective_cluster = cluster_arg
   135→    if plan_data and not cluster_arg and not scope:
   136→        active_cluster = plan_data.get("active_cluster")
   137→        if active_cluster:
   138→            effective_cluster = active_cluster
   139→    return effective_cluster
   140→
   141→
   142→def _build_next_payload(
   143→    *,
   144→    queue: dict,
   145→    items: list[dict],
   146→    state: dict,
   147→    narrative: dict,
   148→    plan_data: dict | None,
   149→) -> dict:
   150→    payload = next_output_mod.build_query_payload(
   151→        queue, items, command="next", narrative=narrative, plan=plan_data
   152→    )
   153→    scores = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   154→    payload["overall_score"] = scores.overall
   155→    payload["objective_score"] = scores.objective
   156→    payload["strict_score"] = scores.strict
   157→    payload["scorecard_dimensions"] = scorecard_dimensions_payload(
   158→        state,
   159→        dim_scores=state.get("dimension_scores", {}),
   160→    )
   161→    payload["subjective_measures"] = [
   162→        row for row in payload["scorecard_dimensions"] if row.get("subjective")
   163→    ]
   164→    return payload
   165→
   166→
   167→def _emit_requested_output(
   168→    opts: NextOptions,
   169→    payload: dict,
   170→    items: list[dict],
   171→) -> bool:
   172→    if opts.output_file:
   173→        if next_output_mod.write_output_file(
   174→            opts.output_file,
   175→            payload,
   176→            len(items),
   177→            safe_write_text_fn=safe_write_text,
   178→            colorize_fn=colorize,
   179→        ):
   180→            return True
   181→        raise CommandError("Failed to write output file")
   182→
   183→    if next_output_mod.emit_non_terminal_output(opts.output_format, payload, items):
   184→        return True
   185→    return False
   186→
   187→
   188→def _plan_queue_context(
   189→    *,
   190→    state: dict,
   191→    plan_data: dict | None,
   192→    context=None,
   193→) -> tuple[float | None, QueueBreakdown | None]:
   194→    effective_plan = context.plan if context is not None else plan_data
   195→    plan_start_strict = get_plan_start_strict(effective_plan)
   196→    try:
   197→        breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan_data, context=context)
   198→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
   199→        breakdown = None
   200→    return plan_start_strict, breakdown
   201→
   202→
   203→def _merge_potentials_safe(raw_potentials: dict | None) -> dict | None:
   204→    try:
   205→        return merge_potentials(raw_potentials) or None
   206→    except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError):
   207→        return raw_potentials or None
   208→
   209→
   210→def _build_and_render_queue(args: argparse.Namespace, state: dict, config: dict) -> None:
   211→    opts = NextOptions.from_args(args)
   212→
   213→    target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(config)
   214→
   215→    # Load the living plan
   216→    plan = load_plan()
   217→    plan_data: dict | None = None
   218→    if (
   219→        plan.get("queue_order")
   220→        or plan.get("overrides")
   221→        or plan.get("clusters")
   222→    ):
   223→        plan_data = plan
   224→
   225→    # Build unified context once — all downstream consumers agree on
   226→    # plan, target_strict, and subjective visibility policy.
   227→    ctx = queue_context(
   228→        state, config=config, plan=plan_data, target_strict=target_strict,
   229→    )
   230→
   231→    # Auto-scope to focus cluster if set and no explicit scope/cluster
   232→    effective_cluster = _resolve_cluster_focus(
   233→        plan_data,
   234→        cluster_arg=opts.cluster,
   235→        scope=opts.scope,
   236→    )
   237→
   238→    queue = build_work_queue(
   239→        state,
   240→        options=QueueBuildOptions(
   241→            count=None,
   242→            scope=opts.scope,
   243→            status=opts.status,
   244→            include_subjective=True,
   245→            subjective_threshold=target_strict,
   246→            explain=opts.explain,
   247→            include_skipped=opts.include_skipped,
   248→            cluster=effective_cluster,
   249→            context=ctx,
   250→        ),
   251→    )
   252→    items = queue.get("items", [])
   253→
   254→    # Collapse auto-clusters into display meta-items
   255→    if plan_data and not effective_cluster and not plan_data.get("active_cluster"):
   256→        items = collapse_clusters(items, plan_data)
   257→
   258→    # Apply count truncation after collapsing
   259→    if opts.count:
   260→        items = items[: opts.count]
   261→        queue["items"] = items
   262→        queue["total"] = len(items)
   263→
   264→    lang = resolve_lang(args)
   265→    lang_name = lang.name if lang else None
   266→    narrative = compute_narrative(
   267→        state,
   268→        context=NarrativeContext(lang=lang_name, command="next", plan=plan_data),
   269→    )
   270→
   271→    payload = _build_next_payload(
   272→        queue=queue,
   273→        items=items,
   274→        state=state,
   275→        narrative=narrative,
   276→        plan_data=plan_data,
   277→    )
   278→    write_query(payload)
   279→
   280→    if _emit_requested_output(opts, payload, items):
   281→        return
   282→
   283→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {})
   284→    issues_scoped = state_mod.path_scoped_issues(
   285→        state.get("issues", {}),
   286→        state.get("scan_path"),
   287→    )
   288→
   289→    # Extract frozen plan-start score and queue breakdown for lifecycle display
   290→    plan_start_strict, breakdown = _plan_queue_context(
   291→        state=state,
   292→        plan_data=plan_data,
   293→        context=ctx,
   294→    )
   295→    queue_total = breakdown.queue_total if breakdown else 0
   296→
   297→    _render_queue_header(queue, opts.explain)
   298→    strict_score = state_mod.score_snapshot(state).strict
   299→    if _show_empty_queue(
   300→        queue,
   301→        strict_score,
   302→        plan_start_strict=plan_start_strict,
   303→        target_strict=target_strict,
   304→    ):
   305→        return
   306→
   307→    raw_potentials = state.get("potentials", {})
   308→    potentials = _merge_potentials_safe(raw_potentials)
   309→    next_render_mod.render_terminal_items(
   310→        items, dim_scores, issues_scoped, group=opts.group, explain=opts.explain,
   311→        potentials=potentials, plan=plan_data,
   312→        cluster_filter=effective_cluster,
   313→    )
   314→    next_nudges_mod.render_single_item_resolution_hint(items)
   315→    next_nudges_mod.render_uncommitted_reminder(plan_data)
   316→    next_nudges_mod.render_followup_nudges(
   317→        state,
   318→        dim_scores,
   319→        issues_scoped,
   320→        strict_score=strict_score,
   321→        target_strict_score=target_strict,
   322→        queue_total=queue_total,
   323→        plan_start_strict=plan_start_strict,
   324→        breakdown=breakdown,
   325→    )
   326→    print()
   327→
   328→    if items and plan_data:
   329→        print_user_message(
   330→            "Hey — the task details are printed above. Just start"
   331→            " working on it. When you're done, resolve it with"
   332→            " `desloppify plan resolve` and then run `desloppify"
   333→            " next` again. If this doesn't seem like the right"
   334→            " priority, run `desloppify plan show` to see the full"
   335→            " queue, or `desloppify plan --help` for all plan tools."
   336→            " Don't stop until you're done — unless I've told you"
   337→            " otherwise, just keep going."
   338→        )
```

```
1→"""Plan reorder subcommand handlers."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import argparse
     6→
     7→from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.runtime import command_runtime
     8→from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.state import require_completed_scan
     9→from desloppify.app.commands.plan._resolve import resolve_ids_from_patterns
    10→from desloppify.base.output.terminal import colorize
    11→from desloppify.engine.plan import append_log_entry, load_plan, move_items, save_plan
    12→
    13→
    14→def resolve_target(plan: dict, target: str | None, position: str) -> str | None:
    15→    """Resolve a cluster name used as a before/after target to a member ID."""
    16→    if target is None:
    17→        return None
    18→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
    19→    if target not in clusters:
    20→        return target
    21→    member_ids = clusters[target].get("issue_ids", [])
    22→    if not member_ids:
    23→        return target
    24→    order = plan.get("queue_order", [])
    25→    member_set = set(member_ids)
    26→    ordered = [fid for fid in order if fid in member_set]
    27→    if not ordered:
    28→        return member_ids[0]
    29→    return ordered[0] if position == "before" else ordered[-1]
    30→
    31→
    32→def cmd_plan_reorder(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
    33→    """Reorder issues in the queue."""
    34→    state = command_runtime(args).state
    35→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
    36→        return
    37→
    38→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
    39→    position: str = getattr(args, "position", "top")
    40→    target: str | None = getattr(args, "target", None)
    41→
    42→    if position in ("before", "after") and target is None:
    43→        print(colorize(f"  '{position}' requires --target (-t). Example: plan reorder <pat> {position} -t <id>", "red"))
    44→        return
    45→    if position in ("up", "down") and target is None:
    46→        print(colorize(f"  '{position}' requires --target (-t) with an integer offset. Example: plan reorder <pat> {position} -t 3", "red"))
    47→        return
    48→
    49→    plan = load_plan()
    50→
    51→    target = resolve_target(plan, target, position)
    52→
    53→    issue_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan)
    54→    if not issue_ids:
    55→        print(colorize("  No matching issues found.", "yellow"))
    56→        return
    57→
    58→    offset: int | None = None
    59→    if position in ("up", "down") and target is not None:
    60→        try:
    61→            offset = int(target)
    62→        except (ValueError, TypeError):
    63→            print(colorize(f"  Invalid offset: {target}", "red"))
    64→            return
    65→        target = None
    66→
    67→    count = move_items(plan, issue_ids, position, target=target, offset=offset)
    68→    append_log_entry(
    69→        plan, "reorder", issue_ids=issue_ids, actor="user",
    70→        detail={"position": position, "target": target, "offset": offset},
    71→    )
    72→    save_plan(plan)
    73→    print(colorize(f"  Moved {count} item(s) to {position}.", "green"))
    74→
    75→
    76→__all__ = ["cmd_plan_reorder", "resolve_target"]
    77→
```

```
   246→    if not is_auto_fix_command(auto_fix_command):
   247→        return
   248→    detector_name = item.get("detector", "")
   249→    similar_count = sum(
   250→        1
   251→        for issue in issues_scoped.values()
   252→        if issue.get("detector") == detector_name and issue["status"] == "open"
   253→    )
   254→    if similar_count <= 1:
   255→        return
   256→    print(
   257→        colorize(
   258→            f"\n  Auto-fixable: {similar_count} similar issues. "
   259→            f"Run `{auto_fix_command}` to fix all at once.",
   260→            "cyan",
   261→        )
   262→    )
   263→
   264→
   265→def _render_item_explain(
   266→    item: dict, detail: dict, confidence: str, dim_scores: dict,
   267→) -> None:
   268→    explanation = item.get("explain", {})
   269→    count_weight = explanation.get("count", int(detail.get("count", 0) or 0))
   270→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   271→    base = (
   272→        f"ranked by confidence={confidence}, "
   273→        f"count={count_weight}, id={item.get('id', '')}"
   274→    )
   275→    if dim_scores and detector:
   276→        dimension = get_dimension_for_detector(detector)
   277→        if dimension and dimension.name in dim_scores:
   278→            ds = dim_scores[dimension.name]
   279→            base += (
   280→                f". Dimension: {dimension.name} at {ds['score']:.1f}% "
   281→                f"({ds.get('failing', 0)} open issues)"
   282→            )
   283→    if item.get("detector") == "review" and dim_scores:
   284→        [REDACTED](item.get("detail", {}).get("dimension", ""))
   285→        if dim_key:
   286→            for ds_name, ds_data in dim_scores.items():
   287→                if _normalized_dimension_key(ds_name) != dim_key:
   288→                    continue
   289→                score_val = ds_data.get("score", "?")
   290→                if isinstance(score_val, int | float):
   291→                    score_str = f"{score_val:.1f}"
   292→                else:
   293→                    score_str = str(score_val)
   294→                base += f". Subjective dimension: {ds_name} at {score_str}%"
   295→                break
   296→    policy = explanation.get("policy")
   297→    if policy:
   298→        base = f"{base}. {policy}"
   299→    print(colorize(f"  explain: {base}", "dim"))
   300→
   301→
   302→def _render_item(
   303→    item: dict, dim_scores: dict, issues_scoped: dict, explain: bool,
   304→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   305→    single_item: bool = False,
   306→    header_showed_plan: bool = False,
   307→) -> None:
   308→    kind = item.get("kind")
   309→    kind_renderer = _KIND_RENDERERS.get(kind)
   310→    if kind_renderer is not None:
   311→        kind_renderer(item)
   312→        return
   313→
   314→    confidence = item.get("confidence", "medium")
   315→    print(colorize(f"  ({confidence} confidence)", "bold"))
   316→    print(colorize("  " + "─" * 60, "dim"))
   317→    print(f"  {colorize(item.get('summary', ''), 'yellow')}")
   318→    _render_item_type(item)
   319→
   320→    if item.get("kind", "issue") == "subjective_dimension":
   321→        _render_subjective_dimension(item, explain=explain)
   322→        return
   323→
   324→    detail = _render_issue_detail(
   325→        item, single_item=single_item, header_showed_plan=header_showed_plan,
   326→    )
   327→    _render_score_impact(item, dim_scores, potentials)
   328→    _render_auto_fix_batch_hint(item, issues_scoped)
   329→    if explain:
   330→        _render_item_explain(item, detail, confidence, dim_scores)
   331→
   332→
   333→def _item_label(item: dict, idx: int, total: int) -> str:
   334→    queue_pos = item.get("queue_position")
   335→    if queue_pos and total > 1:
   336→        return f"  [#{queue_pos}]"
   337→    if total > 1:
   338→        return f"  [{idx + 1}/{total}]"
   339→    pos_str = f"  (#{ queue_pos} in queue)" if queue_pos else ""
   340→    return f"  Next item{pos_str}"
   341→
   342→
   343→def render_terminal_items(
   344→    items: list[dict],
   345→    dim_scores: dict,
   346→    issues_scoped: dict,
   347→    *,
   348→    group: str,
   349→    explain: bool,
   350→    potentials: dict | None = None,
   351→    plan: dict | None = None,
   352→    cluster_filter: str | None = None,
   353→) -> None:
   354→    # Show focus header if plan has active cluster or cluster filter
   355→    effective_cluster = cluster_filter or (plan and plan.get("active_cluster"))
   356→    header_showed_plan = False
   357→    if effective_cluster and plan:
   358→        cluster_name = effective_cluster
   359→        clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   360→        cluster_data = clusters.get(cluster_name, {})
   361→        total = len(cluster_data.get("issue_ids", []))
   362→        print(colorize(f"\n  Focused on: {cluster_name} ({len(items)} of {total} remaining)", "cyan"))
   363→        steps = cluster_data.get("action_steps") or []
   364→        if steps:
   365→            print(colorize("\n  Cluster plan:", "dim"))
   366→            for i, step in enumerate(steps, 1):
   367→                print(colorize(f"    {i}. {step}", "dim"))
   368→            header_showed_plan = True
   369→
   370→    if group != "item":
   371→        _render_grouped(items, group)
   372→        return
   373→
   374→    # Detect cluster drill-in: multiple items with cluster focus active
   375→    is_cluster_drill = len(items) > 1 and (
   376→        cluster_filter or (plan and plan.get("active_cluster"))
   377→    )
   378→
   379→    for idx, item in enumerate(items):
   380→        if idx > 0:
   381→            print()
   382→        # Full card for first item, compact for rest in cluster drill-in
   383→        if is_cluster_drill and idx > 0:
   384→            _render_compact_item(item, idx, len(items))
   385→            continue
   386→        label = _item_label(item, idx, len(items))
   387→        print(colorize(label, "bold"))
   388→        _render_item(
   389→            item, dim_scores, issues_scoped, explain=explain, potentials=potentials,
   390→            single_item=len(items) == 1,
   391→            header_showed_plan=header_showed_plan,
   392→        )
   393→
   394→
   395→__all__ = [
   396→    "render_terminal_items",
   397→]
   398→
```

```
    78→def _snapshot_file(path: Path) -> str | None:

    84→def _restore_file_snapshot(path: Path, snapshot: str | None) -> None:
    85→    if snapshot is None:

    89→            return

    94→def _save_plan_state_transactional(
    95→    *,
    96→    plan: dict,
    97→    plan_path: Path | None,
    98→    state_data: dict,
    99→    state_path_value: Path | None,
   100→) -> None:
   101→    """Persist plan+state together; rollback both files on partial write failure."""
   102→    effective_plan_path = _resolve_plan_file(plan_path)
   103→    effective_state_path = _resolve_state_file(state_path_value)
   104→    plan_snapshot = _snapshot_file(effective_plan_path)
   105→    state_snapshot = _snapshot_file(effective_state_path)
   106→
   107→    try:
   108→        state_mod.save_state(state_data, effective_state_path)
   109→        save_plan(plan, effective_plan_path)
   110→    except Exception:
   111→        _restore_file_snapshot(effective_state_path, state_snapshot)
   112→        _restore_file_snapshot(effective_plan_path, plan_snapshot)
   113→        raise

   399→_CLUSTER_INDIVIDUAL_THRESHOLD = 10
   400→
   401→
   402→def _check_cluster_guard(patterns: list[str], plan: dict, state: dict) -> bool:
   403→    """Return True if blocked by cluster guard, False if OK to proceed."""
   404→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   405→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   406→    for pattern in patterns:
   407→        if pattern in clusters:
   408→            cluster = clusters[pattern]
   409→            # Filter to alive issues only — stale IDs should not count
   410→            ids = [
   411→                fid for fid in cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   412→                if fid in issues and issues[fid].get("status") == "open"
   413→            ]
   414→            if len(ids) == 0:
   415→                print(colorize(
   416→                    f"\n  Cluster '{pattern}' is empty — add items before marking it done.\n",
   417→                    "yellow",
   418→                ))
   419→                print(colorize(
   420→                    f"  Use: desloppify plan cluster add {pattern} <issue-id>",
   421→                    "dim",
   422→                ))
   423→                return True  # blocked
   424→            if len(ids) <= _CLUSTER_INDIVIDUAL_THRESHOLD:
   425→                _print_cluster_guard(pattern, ids, state)
   426→                return True  # blocked
   427→    return False  # OK

   430→def _print_cluster_guard(cluster_name: str, issue_ids: list[str], state: dict) -> None:
   431→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   432→    print(colorize(

   434→        "yellow",

   441→    print(colorize(

   443→        "dim",

   451→def _is_synthetic_id(fid: str) -> bool:
   452→    """Return True if the ID is a synthetic workflow/triage item, not a real issue."""
   453→    return fid.startswith("triage::") or fid.startswith("workflow::") or fid.startswith("subjective::")
   454→
   455→
   456→def _resolve_synthetic_ids(patterns: list[str]) -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
   457→    """Separate synthetic IDs from real issue patterns.
   458→
   459→    Returns (synthetic_ids, remaining_patterns).
   460→    """
   461→    synthetic = [p for p in patterns if _is_synthetic_id(p)]
   462→    remaining = [p for p in patterns if not _is_synthetic_id(p)]
   463→    return synthetic, remaining
   464→
   465→
   466→def _blocked_triage_stages(plan: dict) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
   467→    """Return ``{stage_id: [blocked_by_ids]}`` for triage stages that can't run yet.
   468→
   469→    Uses the dependency graph and confirmed-stage metadata directly —
   470→    no state needed, no queue item construction.
   471→    """
   472→    order_set = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   473→    present = order_set & TRIAGE_IDS
   474→    if not present:
   475→        return {}
   476→
   477→    confirmed = set(plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {}).get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   478→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   479→
   480→    blocked: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   481→    for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names, strict=False):
   482→        if sid not in present or name in confirmed:
   483→            continue
   484→        deps = TRIAGE_STAGE_DEPENDENCIES.get(name, set())
   485→        unmet = sorted(
   486→            f"triage::{dep}" for dep in deps
   487→            if f"triage::{dep}" in present and dep not in confirmed
   488→        )
   489→        if unmet:
   490→            blocked[sid] = unmet
   491→    return blocked

   494→def cmd_plan_resolve(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   495→    """Mark issues as fixed — delegates to cmd_resolve for rich UX."""
   496→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   497→    attestation: str | None = getattr(args, "attest", None)
   498→    note: str | None = getattr(args, "note", None)
   499→
   500→    # --confirm: auto-generate attestation from --note
   501→    if getattr(args, "confirm", False):
   502→        if not note:
   503→            print(colorize("  --confirm requires --note to describe what you did.", "red"))
   504→            return
   505→        attestation = f"I have actually {note} and I am not gaming the score."
   506→        args.attest = attestation
   507→
   508→    # Handle synthetic IDs (triage::*, workflow::*, subjective::*) directly
   509→    synthetic_ids, real_patterns = _resolve_synthetic_ids(patterns)
   510→    if synthetic_ids:
   511→        plan = load_plan()
   512→        # Validate triage dependency chain
   513→        blocked_map = _blocked_triage_stages(plan)
   514→        for sid in synthetic_ids:
   515→            if sid in blocked_map:
   516→                deps = ", ".join(b.replace("triage::", "") for b in blocked_map[sid])
   517→                print(colorize(f"  Cannot resolve {sid} — blocked by: {deps}", "red"))

   777→def cmd_plan_scan_gate(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   778→    """Check or skip the scan requirement for workflow items."""
   779→    skip = getattr(args, "skip", False)
   780→    note: str | None = getattr(args, "note", None)
   781→
   782→    plan = load_plan()
   783→    scan_count_at_start = plan.get("scan_count_at_plan_start")
   784→
   785→    if scan_count_at_start is None:
   786→        print(colorize("  No active plan cycle (plan_start_scores not seeded).", "dim"))
   787→        print(colorize("  Scan gate is not applicable — workflow items gate themselves.", "dim"))
   788→        return
   789→
   790→    resolved_state_path = state_path(args)
   791→    state_data = state_mod.load_state(resolved_state_path)
   792→    current_scan_count = int(state_data.get("scan_count", 0) or 0)
   793→    scan_ran = current_scan_count > scan_count_at_start
   794→    scan_skipped = plan.get("scan_gate_skipped", False)
   795→
   796→    if not skip:
   797→        # Status check
   798→        if scan_ran:
   799→            print(colorize("  Scan gate: PASSED", "green"))
   800→            print(colorize(
   801→                f"  Scans at cycle start: {scan_count_at_start}  "
   802→                f"Current: {current_scan_count}",
   803→                "dim",
   804→            ))
   805→        elif scan_skipped:
   806→            print(colorize("  Scan gate: SKIPPED (manually)", "yellow"))
   807→        else:
   808→            print(colorize("  Scan gate: BLOCKED", "red"))
   809→            print(colorize(
   810→                f"  Scans at cycle start: {scan_count_at_start}  "
   811→                f"Current: {current_scan_count}",
   812→                "dim",
   813→            ))
   814→            print(colorize("  Run: desloppify scan", "dim"))
   815→            print(colorize(
   816→                '  Or:  desloppify plan scan-gate --skip --note "reason"',
   817→                "dim",
   818→            ))
   819→        return
   820→
   821→    # --skip mode
   822→    if scan_ran:
   823→        print(colorize("  Scan already ran this cycle — no skip needed.", "green"))
   824→        return
   825→
   826→    if not note or len(note.strip()) < 50:
   827→        print(colorize(
   828→            "  --skip requires --note with at least 50 chars explaining why.",
   829→            "red",
   830→        ))
   831→        return
   832→
   833→    plan["scan_gate_skipped"] = True
   834→    append_log_entry(
   835→        plan, "scan_gate_skip",
   836→        actor="user",
   837→        note=note,
   838→        detail={
   839→            "scan_count_at_start": scan_count_at_start,
   840→            "current_scan_count": current_scan_count,
   841→        },
   842→    )
   843→    save_plan(plan)
   844→    print(colorize("  Scan requirement marked as satisfied (logged).", "yellow"))
```

```
    30→def _suggest_close_matches(state: dict, plan: dict | None, patterns: list[str]) -> None:
    31→    """Print fuzzy match suggestions for patterns that resolved to zero issues."""
    32→    all_ids: list[str] = list(state.get("issues", {}).keys())
    33→    if plan is not None:
    34→        seen_ids: set[str] = set(all_ids)
    35→        for fid in plan.get("queue_order", []):
    36→            if fid not in seen_ids:
    37→                seen_ids.add(fid)
    38→                all_ids.append(fid)
    39→        for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
    40→            for fid in cluster.get("issue_ids", []):
    41→                if fid not in seen_ids:
    42→                    seen_ids.add(fid)
    43→                    all_ids.append(fid)
    44→
    45→    for pattern in patterns:
    46→        segments = pattern.split("::")
    47→        last_seg = segments[-1]
    48→        suggestions: list[str] = []
    49→
    50→        if _HEX8_RE.match(last_seg):
    51→            suggestions = [fid for fid in all_ids if fid.endswith(f"::{last_seg}") or fid == last_seg]
    52→            if suggestions:
    53→                print(colorize(f"  No match for: {pattern!r}", "yellow"))
    54→                print(colorize("  Did you mean:", "dim"))
    55→                for m in suggestions[:3]:
    56→                    print(colorize(f"    {m}", "dim"))
    57→                print(colorize(f"  Tip: match by hash suffix alone: {last_seg}", "dim"))
    58→            continue
    59→
    60→        # Try last segment and second-to-last as descriptive name slugs
    61→        slug = segments[-2] if len(segments) >= 2 else ""
    62→        for fid in all_ids:
    63→            if f"::{last_seg}::" in fid or fid.endswith(f"::{last_seg}"):
    64→                suggestions.append(fid)
    65→            elif slug and (f"::{slug}::" in fid or fid.endswith(f"::{slug}")):
    66→                suggestions.append(fid)
    67→        if suggestions:
    68→            print(colorize(f"  No match for: {pattern!r}", "yellow"))
    69→            print(colorize("  Did you mean:", "dim"))
    70→            for m in suggestions[:3]:
    71→                print(colorize(f"    {m}", "dim"))

   209→
   210→def _resolve_item_position(
   211→    position: str,
   212→    target: str | None,
   213→    item_ids: list[str],
   214→    ordered_slice: list[str],
   215→    cluster_member_set: set[str],
   216→    cluster_name: str,
   217→    state: dict,
   218→    plan: dict,
   219→) -> tuple[str, str | None, int | None] | None:
   220→    """Resolve where items should be positioned within a cluster.
   221→
   222→    Returns (resolved_position, resolved_target, offset) on success,
   223→    or None if an error was printed and the caller should abort.
   224→    """
   225→    item_set = set(item_ids)
   226→
   227→    if position == "top":
   228→        first_non_item = next((fid for fid in ordered_slice if fid not in item_set), None)
   229→        if first_non_item is None or set(ordered_slice[:len(item_ids)]) == item_set:
   230→            print(colorize("  Already at the top of the cluster.", "yellow"))
   231→            return None
   232→        return ("before", first_non_item, None)
   233→
   234→    if position == "bottom":
   235→        last_non_item = next((fid for fid in reversed(ordered_slice) if fid not in item_set), None)
   236→        if last_non_item is None or set(ordered_slice[-len(item_ids):]) == item_set:
   237→            print(colorize("  Already at the bottom of the cluster.", "yellow"))
   238→            return None
   239→        return ("after", last_non_item, None)
   240→
   241→    if position in ("before", "after"):
   242→        if target is None:
   243→            print(colorize(f"  '{position}' requires a target. Example: --item PAT {position} TARGET", "red"))
   244→            return None
   245→        target_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, [target], plan=plan)
   246→        if not target_ids:
   247→            print(colorize(f"  No match for target {target!r}.", "yellow"))
   248→            return None
   249→        resolved_target = target_ids[0]
   250→        if resolved_target not in cluster_member_set:
   251→            print(colorize(f"  Target {resolved_target!r} is not in cluster {cluster_name!r}.", "red"))
   252→            return None
   253→        return (position, resolved_target, None)
   254→
   255→    if position in ("up", "down"):
   256→        if target is None:
   257→            print(colorize(f"  '{position}' requires an offset. Example: --item PAT {position} 3", "red"))
   258→            return None
   259→        try:
   260→            offset = int(target)
   261→        except (ValueError, TypeError):
   262→            print(colorize(f"  Invalid offset: {target}", "red"))
   263→            return None
   264→        return (position, None, offset)
   265→
   266→    return (position, None, None)
   267→
   268→
   269→def _reorder_within_cluster(
   270→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   271→    plan: dict,
   272→    clusters: dict,
   273→    cluster_names: list[str],
   274→    position: str,
   275→    target: str | None,
   276→    item_pattern: str,
   277→) -> None:
   278→    """Reorder items within a single cluster."""
   279→    if len(cluster_names) != 1:
   280→        print(colorize("  --item requires exactly one cluster name.", "red"))
   281→        return
   282→    cluster_name = cluster_names[0]
   283→    cluster_member_set = set(clusters[cluster_name].get("issue_ids", []))
   284→
   285→    state = command_runtime(args).state
   286→    item_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, [item_pattern], plan=plan)
   287→    if not item_ids:
   288→        print(colorize("  No matching issues found for --item pattern.", "yellow"))
   289→        return
   290→    for fid in item_ids:
   291→        if fid not in cluster_member_set:
   292→            print(colorize(f"  {fid!r} is not a member of cluster {cluster_name!r}.", "red"))
   293→            return
   294→
   295→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   296→    ordered_slice = [fid for fid in queue_order if fid in cluster_member_set]
   297→
   298→    result = _resolve_item_position(
   299→        position, target, item_ids, ordered_slice,
   300→        cluster_member_set, cluster_name, state, plan,
   301→    )
   302→    if result is None:
   303→        return
   304→    resolved_position, resolved_target, offset = result
   305→
   306→    count = move_items(plan, item_ids, resolved_position, target=resolved_target, offset=offset)
   307→    append_log_entry(
   308→        plan, "cluster_reorder", cluster_name=cluster_name, actor="user",
   309→        detail={"position": resolved_position, "count": count, "item": item_pattern},
   310→    )
   311→    save_plan(plan)
   312→    print(colorize(f"  Moved {count} item(s) to {resolved_position} within cluster {cluster_name}.", "green"))
   313→
   314→
   315→def _reorder_whole_clusters(
   316→    plan: dict,
   317→    clusters: dict,
   318→    cluster_names: list[str],
   319→    position: str,
   320→    target: str | None,
   321→) -> None:
   322→    """Reorder entire clusters as blocks relative to each other."""
   323→    target = resolve_target(plan, target, position)
   324→
   325→    offset = None
   326→    if position in ("up", "down") and target is not None:
   327→        try:
   328→            offset = int(target)
   329→        except (ValueError, TypeError):
   330→            print(colorize(f"  Invalid offset: {target}", "red"))
   331→            return
   332→        target = None
   333→
   334→    seen: set[str] = set()
   335→    all_member_ids: list[str] = []
   336→    for name in cluster_names:
   337→        for fid in clusters[name].get("issue_ids", []):
   338→            if fid not in seen:
   339→                seen.add(fid)
   340→                all_member_ids.append(fid)
   341→
   342→    if not all_member_ids:
   343→        print(colorize("  No members in the specified cluster(s).", "yellow"))
   344→        return
   345→
   346→    count = move_items(plan, all_member_ids, position, target=target, offset=offset)
   347→    append_log_entry(
   348→        plan, "cluster_reorder", cluster_name=",".join(cluster_names), actor="user",
   349→        detail={"position": position, "count": count},
   350→    )
   351→    save_plan(plan)
   352→    label = ", ".join(cluster_names)
   353→    print(colorize(f"  Moved cluster(s) {label} ({count} items) to {position}.", "green"))
   354→
   355→
   356→def _cmd_cluster_reorder(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   357→    raw_names: str = getattr(args, "cluster_names", "") or getattr(args, "cluster_name", "")
   358→    cluster_names: list[str] = [n.strip() for n in raw_names.split(",") if n.strip()]
   359→    position: str = getattr(args, "position", "top")
   360→    target: str | None = getattr(args, "target", None)
   361→    item_pattern: str | None = getattr(args, "item_pattern", None)
   362→
   363→    plan = load_plan()
   364→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   365→
   366→    # Validate all names exist
   367→    for name in cluster_names:
   368→        if name not in clusters:
   369→            print(colorize(f"  Cluster {name!r} does not exist.", "red"))
   370→            return
   371→
   372→    if item_pattern is not None:
   373→        _reorder_within_cluster(args, plan, clusters, cluster_names, position, target, item_pattern)
   374→    else:
   375→        _reorder_whole_clusters(plan, clusters, cluster_names, position, target)

   443→def _sorted_clusters_by_queue_pos(
   444→    clusters: dict, queue_order: list[str],
   445→) -> tuple[list[tuple[str, dict]], dict[str, int]]:
   446→    """Sort clusters by their earliest member's position in the queue.
   447→
   448→    Returns (sorted_cluster_pairs, min_pos_cache) where min_pos_cache maps
   449→    cluster name to its earliest queue position (999_999 if no members queued).
   450→    """
   451→    pos_map = {fid: i for i, fid in enumerate(queue_order)}
   452→
   453→    def _min_pos(cluster_data: dict) -> int:
   454→        positions = [pos_map[fid] for fid in cluster_data.get("issue_ids", []) if fid in pos_map]
   455→        return min(positions) if positions else 999_999
   456→
   457→    min_pos_cache = {name: _min_pos(c) for name, c in clusters.items()}
   458→    sorted_clusters = sorted(clusters.items(), key=lambda kv: min_pos_cache[kv[0]])
   459→    return sorted_clusters, min_pos_cache
   460→
   461→
   462→def _print_cluster_list_verbose(
   463→    sorted_clusters: list[tuple[str, dict]],
   464→    min_pos_cache: dict[str, int],
   465→    active: str | None,
   466→) -> None:
   467→    """Print the verbose table view of the cluster list."""
   468→    name_width = max(20, min(35, max(len(n) for n, _ in sorted_clusters)))
   469→    total = len(sorted_clusters)
   470→    print(colorize(f"  Clusters ({total} total, sorted by queue position):", "bold"))
   471→    print()
   472→    header = f"  {'#pos':<5}  {'Name':<{name_width}}  {'Items':>5}  {'Steps':>5}  {'Type':<6}  Description"
   473→    sep = f"  {'─'*4}  {'─'*name_width}  {'─'*5}  {'─'*5}  {'─'*6}  {'─'*45}"
   474→    print(colorize(header, "dim"))
   475→    print(colorize(sep, "dim"))
   476→    for name, cluster in sorted_clusters:
   477→        min_p = min_pos_cache[name]
   478→        pos_str = f"#{min_p}" if min_p < 999_999 else "—"
   479→        member_count = len(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   480→        steps = cluster.get("action_steps") or []
   481→        steps_str = str(len(steps)) if steps else "—"
   482→        type_str = "auto" if cluster.get("auto") else "manual"
   483→        desc = cluster.get("description") or ""
   484→        if not desc and min_p == 999_999 and not member_count:
   485→            desc = "(no queue position — no members)"
   486→        desc_truncated = (desc[:44] + "…") if len(desc) > 45 else desc
   487→        name_display = (name[:name_width - 1] + "…") if len(name) > name_width else name
   488→        focused = " *" if name == active else ""
   489→        print(f"  {pos_str:>5}  {name_display:<{name_width}}  {member_count:>5}  {steps_str:>5}  {type_str:<6}  {desc_truncated}{focused}")
   490→    print()
   491→
   492→
   493→def _cmd_cluster_list(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   494→    plan = load_plan()
   495→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   496→    active = plan.get("active_cluster")
   497→    verbose: bool = getattr(args, "verbose", False)
   498→
   499→    if not clusters:
   500→        print("  No clusters defined.")
   501→        return
   502→
   503→    queue_order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   504→    sorted_clusters, min_pos_cache = _sorted_clusters_by_queue_pos(clusters, queue_order)
   505→
   506→    if verbose:
   507→        _print_cluster_list_verbose(sorted_clusters, min_pos_cache, active)
   508→        return
   509→
   510→    print(colorize("  Clusters (ordered by queue position):", "bold"))
   511→    for name, cluster in sorted_clusters:
   512→        min_p = min_pos_cache[name]
   513→        pos_str = f"#{min_p}" if min_p < 999_999 else "—"
   514→        member_count = len(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   515→        desc = cluster.get("description") or ""
   516→        marker = " (focused)" if name == active else ""
   517→        desc_str = f" — {desc}" if desc else ""
   518→        auto_tag = " [auto]" if cluster.get("auto") else ""
   519→        print(f"    {pos_str:>5}  {name}: {member_count} items{auto_tag}{desc_str}{marker}")
   520→

   585→def cmd_cluster_dispatch(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   586→    """Route cluster subcommands."""
   587→    cluster_action = getattr(args, "cluster_action", None)
   588→    dispatch = {
   589→        "create": _cmd_cluster_create,
   590→        "add": _cmd_cluster_add,
   591→        "remove": _cmd_cluster_remove,
   592→        "delete": _cmd_cluster_delete,
   593→        "reorder": _cmd_cluster_reorder,
   594→        "show": _cmd_cluster_show,
   595→        "list": _cmd_cluster_list,
   596→        "update": _cmd_cluster_update,
   597→        "merge": _cmd_cluster_merge,
   598→    }
   599→    handler = dispatch.get(cluster_action)
   600→    if handler is None:
   601→        _cmd_cluster_list(args)
   602→        return
   603→    handler(args)
   604→
   605→
   606→__all__ = ["cmd_cluster_dispatch"]
```

```
    78→def _snapshot_file(path: Path) -> str | None:
    79→    if not path.exists():
    80→        return None
    81→    return path.read_text()
    82→
    83→
    84→def _restore_file_snapshot(path: Path, snapshot: str | None) -> None:
    85→    if snapshot is None:
    86→        try:
    87→            path.unlink()
    88→        except FileNotFoundError:
    89→            return
    90→        return
    91→    safe_write_text(path, snapshot)

    94→def _save_plan_state_transactional(
    95→    *,
    96→    plan: dict,
    97→    plan_path: Path | None,
    98→    state_data: dict,
    99→    state_path_value: Path | None,
   100→) -> None:
   101→    """Persist plan+state together; rollback both files on partial write failure."""
   102→    effective_plan_path = _resolve_plan_file(plan_path)
   103→    effective_state_path = _resolve_state_file(state_path_value)
   104→    plan_snapshot = _snapshot_file(effective_plan_path)
   105→    state_snapshot = _snapshot_file(effective_state_path)
   106→
   107→    try:
   108→        state_mod.save_state(state_data, effective_state_path)
   109→        save_plan(plan, effective_plan_path)
   110→    except Exception:
   111→        _restore_file_snapshot(effective_state_path, state_snapshot)
   112→        _restore_file_snapshot(effective_plan_path, plan_snapshot)
   113→        raise

   218→def cmd_plan_skip(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   219→    """Skip issues — unified command for temporary/permanent/false-positive."""
   220→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   221→    state = runtime.state
   222→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
   223→        return
   224→
   225→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   226→    reason: str | None = getattr(args, "reason", None)
   227→    review_after: int | None = getattr(args, "review_after", None)
   228→    permanent: bool = getattr(args, "permanent", False)
   229→    false_positive: bool = getattr(args, "false_positive", False)
   230→    note: str | None = getattr(args, "note", None)
   231→    attestation: str | None = getattr(args, "attest", None)
   232→
   233→    kind = skip_kind_from_flags(permanent=permanent, false_positive=false_positive)
   234→    if not _validate_skip_requirements(
   235→        kind=kind,
   236→        attestation=attestation,
   237→        note=note,
   238→    ):
   239→        return
   240→
   241→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   242→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   243→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   244→    issue_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan)
   245→    if not issue_ids:
   246→        print(colorize("  No matching issues found.", "yellow"))
   247→        return
   248→
   249→    # For permanent/false_positive: delegate to state layer for score impact
   250→    state_data = _apply_state_skip_resolution(
   251→        kind=kind,
   252→        state_file=state_file,
   253→        issue_ids=issue_ids,
   254→        note=note,
   255→        attestation=attestation,
   256→    )
   257→
   258→    scan_count = state.get("scan_count", 0)
   259→    count = skip_items(
   260→        plan,
   261→        issue_ids,
   262→        kind=kind,
   263→        reason=reason,
   264→        note=note,
   265→        attestation=attestation,
   266→        review_after=review_after,
   267→        scan_count=scan_count,
   268→    )
   269→
   270→    # Log the skip action
   271→    append_log_entry(
   272→        plan,
   273→        "skip",
   274→        issue_ids=issue_ids,
   275→        actor="user",
   276→        note=note,
   277→        detail={"kind": kind, "reason": reason},
   278→    )
   279→    if state_data is not None:
   280→        _save_plan_state_transactional(
   281→            plan=plan,
   282→            plan_path=plan_file,
   283→            state_data=state_data,
   284→            state_path_value=state_file,
   285→        )
   286→    else:
   287→        save_plan(plan, plan_file)
   288→
   289→    print(colorize(f"  {SKIP_KIND_LABELS[kind]} {count} item(s).", "green"))
   290→    if review_after:
   291→        print(colorize(f"  Will re-surface after {review_after} scan(s).", "dim"))
   292→    print_user_message(
   293→        "Hey — if skipping was the right call, just continue with"
   294→        " what you were doing. If you think a broader re-triage is"
   295→        " needed, use `desloppify plan triage`. Run `desloppify"
   296→        " plan --help` to see all available plan tools. Otherwise"
   297→        " no need to reply, just keep going."
   298→    )

   301→def cmd_plan_unskip(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   302→    """Unskip issues — bring back to queue."""
   303→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   304→    state = runtime.state
   305→    if not require_completed_scan(state):
   306→        return
   307→
   308→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   309→
   310→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   311→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   312→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   313→    # For unskip we need to match against all statuses (skipped items may be wontfix/fp)
   314→    issue_ids = resolve_ids_from_patterns(state, patterns, plan=plan, status_filter="all")
   315→    if not issue_ids:
   316→        print(colorize("  No matching issues found.", "yellow"))
   317→        return
   318→
   319→    count, need_reopen = unskip_items(plan, issue_ids)
   320→    append_log_entry(
   321→        plan, "unskip", issue_ids=issue_ids, actor="user",
   322→        detail={"need_reopen": need_reopen},
   323→    )
   324→
   325→    # Reopen permanent/false_positive items in state
   326→    reopened: list[str] = []
   327→    if need_reopen:
   328→        state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   329→        for fid in need_reopen:
   330→            reopened.extend(state_mod.resolve_issues(state_data, fid, "open"))
   331→        _save_plan_state_transactional(
   332→            plan=plan,
   333→            plan_path=plan_file,
   334→            state_data=state_data,
   335→            state_path_value=state_file,
   336→        )
   337→        print(colorize(f"  Reopened {len(reopened)} issue(s) in state.", "dim"))
   338→    else:
   339→        save_plan(plan, plan_file)
   340→
   341→    print(colorize(f"  Unskipped {count} item(s) — back in queue.", "green"))
   342→

   348→def cmd_plan_reopen(args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
   349→    """Reopen resolved issues from plan context."""
   350→    patterns: list[str] = getattr(args, "patterns", [])
   351→
   352→    raw_state_path = state_path(args)
   353→    state_file = raw_state_path if isinstance(raw_state_path, Path) else Path(raw_state_path) if raw_state_path else None
   354→    state_data = state_mod.load_state(state_file)
   355→    plan_file = _plan_file_for_state(state_file)
   356→
   357→    reopened: list[str] = []
   358→    for pattern in patterns:
   359→        reopened.extend(
   360→            state_mod.resolve_issues(state_data, pattern, "open")
   361→        )
   362→
   363→    if not reopened:
   364→        print(colorize("  No resolved issues matching: " + " ".join(patterns), "yellow"))
   365→        return
   366→
   367→    # Remove from skipped if present, and ensure all reopened IDs are in queue
   368→    plan = load_plan(plan_file)
   369→
   370→    # Remove from commit tracking uncommitted list
   371→    purge_uncommitted_ids(plan, reopened)
   372→
   373→    skipped = plan.get("skipped", {})
   374→    count = 0
   375→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   376→    for fid in reopened:
   377→        if fid in skipped:
   378→            skipped.pop(fid)
   379→            count += 1
   380→        if fid not in order:
   381→            plan["queue_order"].append(fid)
   382→            order.add(fid)
   383→            count += 1
   384→    append_log_entry(
   385→        plan, "reopen", issue_ids=reopened, actor="user",
   386→    )
   387→    _save_plan_state_transactional(
   388→        plan=plan,
   389→        plan_path=plan_file,
   390→        state_data=state_data,
   391→        state_path_value=state_file,
   392→    )
   393→
   394→    print(colorize(f"  Reopened {len(reopened)} issue(s).", "green"))
   395→    if count:
   396→        print(colorize("  Plan updated: items moved back to queue.", "dim"))
   397→
   398→
   399→_CLUSTER_INDIVIDUAL_THRESHOLD = 10
   400→
   401→
   402→def _check_cluster_guard(patterns: list[str], plan: dict, state: dict) -> bool:
   403→    """Return True if blocked by cluster guard, False if OK to proceed."""
   404→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   405→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   406→    for pattern in patterns:
   407→        if pattern in clusters:
   408→            cluster = clusters[pattern]
   409→            # Filter to alive issues only — stale IDs should not count
   410→            ids = [
   411→                fid for fid in cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   412→                if fid in issues and issues[fid].get("status") == "open"
   413→            ]
   414→            if len(ids) == 0:
   415→                print(colorize(
   416→                    f"\n  Cluster '{pattern}' is empty — add items before marking it done.\n",
   417→                    "yellow",
   418→                ))
   419→                print(colorize(
   420→                    f"  Use: desloppify plan cluster add {pattern} <issue-id>",
   421→                    "dim",
   422→                ))
   423→                return True  # blocked
   424→            if len(ids) <= _CLUSTER_INDIVIDUAL_THRESHOLD:
   425→                _print_cluster_guard(pattern, ids, state)
   426→                return True  # blocked
   427→    return False  # OK
   428→
   429→
   430→def _print_cluster_guard(cluster_name: str, issue_ids: list[str], state: dict) -> None:
   431→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   432→    print(colorize(
   433→        f"\n  Cluster '{cluster_name}' has {len(issue_ids)} item(s) — mark them done individually first:\n",
   434→        "yellow",
   435→    ))
   436→    for fid in issue_ids:
   437→        f = issues.get(fid, {})
   438→        summary = f.get("summary", "(no summary)")[:80]
   439→        detector = f.get("detector", "?")
   440→        print(f"    {fid}  [{detector}]  {summary}")
   441→    print(colorize(
   442→        "\n  Use: desloppify resolve <id> --status fixed --note '...' --attest '...'",
   443→        "dim",
   444→    ))
   445→    print(colorize(
   446→        "  Or mark each resolved: desloppify plan resolve <id> --note '...' --confirm\n",
   447→        "dim",
   448→    ))
```
